'''Prince Ali Rescue''' is a [[free-to-play]] [[quest]], and one of the first released. It's notable for allowing entry through the [[Al Kharid]]/[[Lumbridge]] [[Al Kharid gate|gate]] without the fee of 10 [[coins]]. It also introduces characters who are a part of the [[Quests/Series#Kharidian|Kharidian]] quest series.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Hassan]] in the palace at [[Al Kharid]].
|startmap = 3301,3163
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Prince Ali of Al Kharid has been kidnapped by the scheming Lady Keli. You are hired to stage a rescue mission.
|length = Short
|requirements = The ability to get past [[aggressive]] [[combat level]] 26 [[jail guard]]s.
|items = *[[Soft clay]]
*3 [[balls of wool]]
*[[Yellow dye]] or 2 [[onion]]s and 5 [[coins]]
*[[Redberries]]
*[[Ashes]]
*[[Bucket of water]] or [[jug of water]] (obtainable during quest)
*[[Pot of flour]]
*[[Bronze bar]]
*[[Pink skirt]]
*3 [[beer]]s
*[[Rope]] (can be bought during the quest from [[Ned]] for 18 [[coins]])
*30-40 [[coins]] for the Al Kharid [[toll gate]] if not using teleports to and from Al Kharid
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|10|link=yes}}
*Fast travel to several locations:
**''(Members only)'' Al Kharid (2 trips) - [[Amulet of glory]] or [[ring of dueling]]
**''(Members only)'' Draynor Village (2 trips) - [[Amulet of glory]] or [[necklace of passage]] to Wizards' Tower
*Quick access to a furnace:
**''(Members only)'' [[Amulet of glory]] to [[Edgeville]]
**[[Lumbridge Teleport]] or [[Lumbridge Home Teleport]]
|kills = [[Jail guard]] (level 26, optional)
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Setting up (obtaining the required items)===
{{Needed|axe, tinderbox, pickaxe, shears, 16 [[coins]]}}
'''Skip this part if you have all the required items''' (can be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]]).

{{Checklist|
*Purchase the [[pink skirt]] at [[Thessalia's Fine Clothes]] immediately south of the [[Varrock]] town square.
*Buy 3 [[beer]]s at the [[Blue Moon Inn]] just south-east of [[Thessalia's Fine Clothes]], and pick up the [[pot]] in the bar.
*Cut down a tree, light the [[logs]], then wait for it to burn out to take the [[ashes]].
*Head to the [[south-east Varrock mine]] and mine one [[Tin ore|tin]] and one [[copper ore]] to later make a [[bronze bar]], and pick one bunch of [[redberries]] from the nearby bushes.
*Head to the [[south-west Varrock mine]], and mine one [[clay]].
*Head to [[Fred the Farmer]]'s pen north of [[Lumbridge]] and shear three [[sheep]] for [[wool]]. Pick two [[onions]] from the garden behind his house.
*Pick some [[wheat]] from the nearby grain field, then make a [[pot of flour]] at the [[windmill]].
*Spin the wool on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Lumbridge Castle]] using the [[spinning wheel]] to get three [[balls of wool]].
*Take the [[jug]] from the castle's kitchen basement and fill it with water, then use it on your [[clay]] to create [[soft clay]], and then refill it.
*Head to [[Al Kharid]] through the toll gate to the east across the river with your 10 [[coins]], and smelt a [[bronze bar]] in the furnace there.
}}

The remaining items can be gathered during the quest.

===Planning a rescue===
{{Needed|3 [[balls of wool]], [[rope]] (unless buying from [[Ned]]), 2 [[onion]]s '''or''' [[yellow dye]], 1 [[redberries]], [[pot of flour]], [[ashes]], a [[bucket of water]] or [[jug of water]], [[soft clay]], a [[bronze bar]], 3 normal beers, a [[pink skirt]], and 30 [[coins]] (unless teleporting)}}
[[File:Chancellor Hassan chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Map|name=Leela|x=3113|y=3262|plane=0|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Leela's location just east of Draynor Village.|align=right|width=250|height=250}}
Head to the [[Al Kharid palace]], located in the south of [[Al Kharid]]. There is a [[jug of water]] in the eastern room if you did not bring one. Talk to [[Chancellor Hassan]] in the southern chamber and ask if he needs help; he will direct you towards Spymaster [[Osman]], who can be found outside the northern perimeter of the palace. Osman will explain that Prince Ali, heir to the Emir of Al Kharid, has been taken by a group of bandits to the abandoned jail just east of [[Draynor Village]]. He wants you to talk to his daughter [[Leela]], who will help you attempt a rescue.

[[Leela]] can be found strolling east of [[Draynor Village]] just south of the wheat field. Talk to Leela and ask her about the key and disguise, and she will explain what you will need to pull off the escape.

To the west of Leela is [[Ned]]'s house. Ask him to make you a wig from the [[balls of wool]]. If you haven't brought a rope, you can buy one from his shop for 18 [[coins]] (15 through dialogue). Once you have the rope and wig, talk to [[Aggie]] in the house just west of Ned's, and ask her to make you some [[Paste|paste]]. She will use your [[redberries]], [[ashes]], [[flour]] and [[water]] to make the paste. If you did not bring yellow dye, you can ask her to make it for you in exchange for 2 [[onion]]s and five coins. Use the dye on the wig to dye it yellow.

[[File:Draynor jail front.png|thumb|left|200px|Guards patrolling the Draynor jail.]]

Head inside the jail directly east of [[Draynor]], avoiding the aggressive level 26 [[jail guard]]s. They will ignore you if your combat level is 53 or higher. Once inside, speak to [[Lady Keli]] and tell her she's famous, then ask her about her latest plan, then praise her skill. Ask her how she knows someone won't try to free him, and she'll mention the key. Ask her if you can see the key and then if you can touch the key for a short amount of time. You will make a [[key print]] of the key using the [[soft clay]]. {{Chat option|1Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!|1What is your latest plan then?|2How do you know someone won't try to free him?|1Could I see the key please?|1Could I touch the key for a moment please?}}

Once you have the key print, head to any furnace to smelt the [[Bronze key (Prince Ali Rescue|bronze key]] using the key print and your [[bronze bar]]. The closest is in [[Lumbridge]]. [[Members]] may use a [[Amulet of glory]] to teleport to the [[Edgeville furnace]], and then to teleport to [[Draynor Village]] for the next section.
{{Clear|left}}

===Saving the Prince===
{{Needed|3 [[beer]]s, [[rope]], a [[pink skirt]], a [[wig]] (dyed yellow), and [[paste]]}}
[[File:Prince Ali chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Leela]], who will tell you to talk to [[Joe (jail)|Joe]] the guard to find a weakness before breaking the prince out.

'''Note''': If she doesn't tell you to talk to the guard, you may have forgotten to dye the wig yellow.

Talk to Joe and offer him a drink of all three beers, until he is drunk. Use the rope on [[Lady Keli]], the key on the cell door, then talk to [[Prince Ali]] and he will use the [[wig]] and [[pink skirt]] as a disguise and escape.

Return to [[Hassan]] in the Al Kharid palace to claim your reward.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip:''' [[Members]] may talk to [[Osman]] outside the palace after the quest to unlock the [[Minigame Teleport]] to the [[Sorceress's Garden]].

==Rewards==
{{Obsolete|The image doesn't include the new quest rewards|update=Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More}}
{{Quest rewards
|name = Prince Ali Rescue
|image = [[File:Prince Ali Rescue reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 3
|rewards =
*700 [[coins]]
*Free passage through the [[Lumbridge]] - [[Al Kharid]] toll gate from now on.
*{{SCP|Smithing|500|link=yes}} experience
*{{SCP|Crafting|500|link=yes}} experience
*(Members) Access to the [[Sorceress's Garden]] [[Thieving]] [[minigame]].
*(Members) Use of the window shortcut at the rear of [[Al Kharid Palace]] (requires 70 [[Agility]]).
}}

==Required for completing==
Completion of Prince Ali Rescue is required for the following:
* [[Contact!]]

'''Pirate's Treasure''' is a quest in which you help the pirate [[Redbeard Frank]] obtain some [[Karamjan rum]] in return for the location of the treasure of [[One-Eyed Hector]], his old captain.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Redbeard Frank]] at the northernmost dock at [[Port Sarim]], just outside [[The Rusty Anchor]].
|startmap = 3052,3252
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Redbeard Frank knows the location of pirate treasure, but he'll only part with the knowledge for a bottle of [[Karamjan rum]].
|length = Very Short
|requirements = Able to defeat or run away from a [[Combat level]] 4 [[gardener]].
|items = *[[Karamjan rum]] (obtainable during the quest for 30 coins)
*[[White apron]] (obtainable during the quest in Port Sarim at [[Gerrant's Fishy Business.]])
*60 [[coins]] (only 30 are needed if using the [[Ring of Charos(a)]])
*10 [[banana]]s (obtainable during the quest)
*[[Spade]] (obtainable during the quest)
|recommended = *Fast travel to several locations
**[[Port Sarim]] to start the quest - [[Amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]] or [[Explorer's ring]] 2-4 or [[Teleport to House]] (Rimmington) or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Crafting Guild]]
**[[Varrock]] (1 trip) - [[Varrock Teleport]] or [[Chronicle]] or [[Ring of wealth]] or [[Skills necklace]]
**[[Falador Park]] (1 trip) - [[Ring of wealth]] or [[Falador Teleport]]
|kills = [[Gardener]] ''(level 4, optional)''
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Not completable, as it requires access to Misthalin.
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Morytania}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Captain Redbeard===
{{Needed|60 [[coins]].}}
[[File:Redbeard Frank chathead.png|left|frameless|100px]]
Talk to [[Redbeard Frank]] located in front of the northernmost dock in [[Port Sarim]]. Tell him you are in search of treasure, and he will ask you to bring him some [[Karamjan rum]] before he'll tell you where to find some.

Walk south on the docks to see three sailors (NOT the [[Monk of Entrana|Monks of Entrana]]). Talk to any one of these sailors to board the ship to [[Karamja]] for 30 [[coins]] (free using the [[Ring of Charos(a)]]).
{{Clear}}
===Rum smuggling===
{{Needed|30 [[coins]].}}
{{Map|name=Pirate's Treasure crate|x=2939|y=3149|r=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of the crate used to hide the rum.|width=200|height=200}}
[[File:Zembo chathead.png|left|frameless]]
When you arrive in Karamja, follow the path to the west and enter the [[Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers|bar]]. Trade with [[Zembo]] and buy one [[Karamjan rum]].

'''Do not leave the island''' with the rum - it will be confiscated by the [[Customs officer|officers]] as [[Asgarnia]] has banned the import of intoxicating spirits. The bottle will also break if you teleport or accept a [[random event]] where you would be temporarily teleported.

You will need to find a method to smuggle the rum off the island. First, pick 10 [[banana]]s from the plantation to the north. Then talk to [[Luthas]] in his hut to the east of the plantation and ask him for a job, and he will hire you as his worker.

Outside the south east corner of his hut is a [[Crate (Pirate's Treasure)|crate]]. Use the rum on it to hide it in the crate, then "Fill Crate" on it to fill it with bananas.

'''Note''': If you get a message saying "Why would I want to do that?" make sure you have asked for employment first.

Talk to Luthas again and he will pay you 30 coins for loading the crate. Ask him where the crate goes, and he will tell you they go to [[Wydin]], who owns the food store in [[Port Sarim]]. Travel back to Port Sarim at the customs officer to the east for 30 coins (free with [[Ring of Charos(a)]]).

===Retrieving the rum===
{{Map|name=Chest|x=3219|y=3396|plane=1|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of Hector's chest.|width=200|height=200}}
{{Needed|recommended=a teleport to [[Varrock Teleport|Varrock]] and [[Falador Teleport|Falador]].}}
[[File:Wydin chathead.png|left]]
Once you are in Port Sarim, make a quick stop at [[Gerrant's Fishy Business|the fishing shop]] just to the west. Hanging on the back wall is a [[white apron]]. Take it and wear it.

Talk to [[Wydin]] at his [[Wydin's Food Store|food store]] directly south of the fishing shop, and ask him for a job. He will agree as long as you are wearing your [[white apron]]. Enter the back room and search the [[Crate (Food Store, banana)|crate]] with a [[banana]] on top of it. You will find the rum. '''Do not teleport with it in your inventory (including random events).''' Head back to [[Redbeard Frank]] and give him the drink.

Frank will give you a [[Chest key (Pirate's Treasure)|key]] to the chest found upstairs in [[Varrock|Varrock's]] [[Blue Moon Inn]], owned by the now deceased [[One-Eyed Hector]]. Travel to [[Varrock]] and head to the [[Blue Moon Inn]] located just north of the city's southern gate. Go upstairs and find the chest in the room at the end of the hall. Use the key on the chest to find a [[pirate message]]. It will give you a clue to the treasure's location. '''Be sure to read the clue'''.

===Buried treasure===
{{Needed|[[Spade]], [[pirate message]]|recommended=A [[weapon]].}}
[[File:Gardener chathead.png|left]]
[[File:Pirate's Treasure - Buried treasure location.png|thumb|200px|Location of the buried treasure.]]
Travel to Falador Park, located in the north of Falador. If you don't yet have a spade, grab one from the estate agency just south-west of the park. Find the statue of [[Saradomin]] in the middle of the park, and notice where it's pointing. Note the configuration of the dirt, which vaguely makes an X. Stand in the middle of the dirt "X" and dig.
An angry level-4 [[gardener]] will appear out of nowhere and attack you. You will be unable to dig again until you either kill him, or run out of the park to despawn him. Dig again in the same spot to get a casket and complete the quest.
{{Map|name=Chest|x=2999|y=3383|plane=0|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Location of the buried treasure.|width=200|height=200}}

'''Congratulations, Quest Complete!'''

==Reward==
{{Obsolete|The image doesn't include the new quest rewards|update=Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More}}
{{Quest rewards
|name = Pirate's Treasure
|image = [[File:Pirate's Treasure reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 2
|rewards =
*Access to [[Casket (Pirate's Treasure)|One-Eyed Hector's Treasure Chest]] (contains a [[gold ring]], an [[emerald]], and 450 [[coins]]).
*{{SCP|Cooking|800|link=yes}} experience
}}

Completion of Pirate's Treasure is required for the following:

==Trivia==
*When using the Casket received as a reward for completing the quest on Redbeard Frank, the player's character offers to share the treasure with him, but he refuses and insists that the player should keep all of it for their own as they have earned it.
*When the quest was first released, the [[Karamja rum]] was tradeable and the bottles would not break if players tried to teleport. Some players simply bought a whole load of rum and sold it to players doing the quest, allowing them to skip a large part of it. When this was posted on fan forums, a Jagex developer saw it and the problem was soon corrected.
*If you have completed [[Rum Deal]] prior to starting this quest, you will ask Redbeard Frank if [[Braindeath 'Rum']] will do instead instead of Karamjan rum, in which case Redbeard refuses immediately, calling it 'swill'.
*If you give Redbeard Frank some [[Karamjan rum (sliced banana)|Karamja rum with sliced banana]] in it, he will take it at first, but will give it back when talked to again, stating that he doesn't like bananas in his rum.
*If you give Redbeard Frank some [[Karamjan rum (banana)|Karamja rum with a banana]] stuffed in it, he will take it at first, but will give it back, saying "Arr - this here rum's got a banana stuck in it!".
*As the completed quest journal text indicates, it was at one time necessary to complete the quest in order to travel between Port Sarim and Musa Point, as well as to continue to work for Luthas.

{{Pirate's Treasure}}

{{External|rs|rsc=Merlin's crystal}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Merlin's Crystal |number = 21 |image = [[File:Merlin's Crystal.png|300px]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Camelot|Camelot]], #1 |developer = [[Paul Gower]] }} '''Merlin's Crystal''' is the first quest in the [[Camelot quest series]], and involves the player rescuing the wizard [[Merlin]] from a crystal. ==Details== {{Quest details |description = The wizard [[Merlin]] has been trapped in a magical crystal by the witch [[Morgan Le Faye]]. So far, King Arthur hasn't been able to figure out how to free his mentor from his crystal prison. Can you help? |start = Talk to [[King Arthur]] in [[Camelot]]. |startmap = 2764,3513 |difficulty = Intermediate |length = Short |requirements = Must be able to defeat a level 39 enemy. You do not need to have an Attack level of 20 to free Merlin, you can 'Use' Excalibur on the crystal to free him. |items = *[[Bread]] *[[Tinderbox]] *[[Bucket of wax]] (obtainable during the quest with either the [[Beekeeper's outfit]] or [[insect repellent]]; a [[bucket]] spawns near the east gate of the beehive enclosure) *[[Bat bones]] (obtainable during the quest) |recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|20|link=yes}} *[[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s *Fast travel to several locations **Camelot ([[Camelot teleport]]) **Falador ([[Falador teleport]]) **Varrock ([[Varrock teleport]], [[Chronicle]] or [[combat bracelet]] to the Champions' Guild) **Taverley ([[Taverley teleport]], [[Balloon Transport System]] or [[Teleport to House]] if your house is in Taverley) **Port Sarim ([[Explorer's Ring 2]], [[Rat Pits]] or [[Pest Control]] [[minigame]] teleport, or [[Teleport to House]] if your house is in Rimmington) |kills = * [[Sir Mordred]] ''(level 39)'' * [[Giant bat]] ''(level 27)'' (optional, to acquire [[bat bones]]) |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===Merlin's predicament=== [[File:King Arthur chathead.png|left]] {{map|width=250|height=250|align=right|zoom=2|x=2759|y=3500|caption= {{legend|#F0FF00|caption=King Arthur}} {{legend|#00FF00|caption=Sir Gawain}} |mtype:pin,icon:yellowPin,2764:3515 |mtype:pin,2763:3506 |mtype:text,class:,label:Camelot
Castle,2759:3484 }} Head to [[Camelot]], east of [[Seers' Village]]. Ask [[King Arthur]] if you can join the Knights of the Round Table, and he'll suggest you complete a quest first to prove yourself; [[Merlin]] has been found trapped in a crystal. He wants you to ask the other knights for ideas on how to rescue him. {{Clear|left}} ===Gathering information=== [[File:Sir Gawain chathead.png|left|frameless]] Speak to [[Sir Gawain]], found either within the castle or roaming in the courtyard. Ask him how Merlin got trapped, and he will suspect it to be the work of [[Morgan Le Faye]]. However, he does not know how to get into her [[Keep Le Faye|keep]], which is guarded by [[Mordred]] and his group of renegade knights. Next, talk to [[Sir Lancelot]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}. Ask him if he has any ideas on how to get into the keep. He will mention that there is a sea entrance to the keep, and that the knights get all of their deliveries by boat from [[Catherby]]. {{Clear|left}} ===Infiltrating the keep=== {{Needed|recommended=Combat equipment, food}} Now that you have a lead, follow the road south-east to [[Catherby]]. If you do not already have a [[bucket of wax]], pick up the nearby [[insect repellent]] for use later, which can be found on a table in the house containing [[Perdu]] just north of the bank. Ensure you have your combat equipment, then head just north of the dock between the bank and the [[Candle Shop]], where you'll find a few crates against the back of the shop. Click on them to hide inside. There will be a bit of dialogue as workers come to pack you up and put you in the boat. After a while, you'll end up in the [[Keep Le Faye]]; when prompted, choose yes to climb out. ===Defeating Mordred=== [[File:Merlin's Crystal - Fighting Sir Mordred.png|thumb|220px|Fighting Sir Mordred.]] [[File:Sir Mordred chathead.png|left|frameless]] Head up the stairs to the top floor, ignoring the [[renegade knight]]s that are wandering around the castle. You should find [[Sir Mordred]] (level 39); fight him, and just as you are about to defeat him, [[Morgan Le Faye]] will appear and beg for her son's life. '''Do not select the option to kill him or interrupt the conversation, or you'll need to fight Mordred again. Running out of Prayer will interrupt it.''' Agree to spare him in return for information on how to untrap Merlin, and she will tell you that you will need a magic symbol, bat bones, and a black candle, in order to summon a mighty spirit. You'll need to bind the spirit with magic words, and then obtain the sword [[Excalibur]] to finally shatter the crystal. {{Clear|left}} ===Obtaining the items=== {{Needed|[[bread]], [[bat bones]] (obtainable below), [[bucket of wax]] (obtainable below)|recommended=Fast travel method to Taverley, Port Sarim, Varrock and Camelot for subsequent sections}} ====Bat bones==== If you did not bring [[bat bones]], you can obtain some by descending the stairs to the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and leaving through the doors, then killing the [[giant bat]]s around the keep. :'''Note:''' Upon leaving the keep, you will only be able to return through the Catherby crates. ====Black candle==== The [[black candle]] can be obtained by bringing a [[bucket of wax]] to the [[candle maker]] in [[Catherby]], located in his house west of the bank. Ask him about black candles, then talk to him again to give him the wax. If you do not yet have a [[bucket of wax]], head to the fenced-in area north of the keep, by the flax field. Pick up a bucket by the gate. If you have [[insect repellent]], use it on one of the beehives, then use the bucket on the beehive to obtain your bucket of wax. If you wear the [[Beekeeper's outfit]], you can simply click the beehive with the bucket in your inventory, without needing to use insect repellant. ====Excalibur==== {{Needed|[[Bread]]}} [[File:Merlin's Crystal - Lady of the Lake.png|thumb|180px|The Lady of the Lake]] [[File:The Lady of the Lake chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]] The sword is kept by [[The Lady of the Lake]], found by the lake within [[Taverley]], in the peninsula just south of the [[Hot Air Balloon]]. Tell her you seek Excalibur, and she will say that she will only give it to one who is worthy and good. She has set a test for you; she wants you to first enter the [[Port Sarim]] [[Grum's Gold Exchange|Jeweller's shop]]. Head to [[Port Sarim]]. If you don't have any bread, you can make [[bread dough]] on the [[cooking range]] just south of the Jeweller's shop. Purchase a [[pot of flour]] from [[Wydin's Food Store]], a bucket from the [[Trader crewmember]]'s on the southernmost dock, fill it at the sink east of the [[magic shop]], then use it on the flour to make [[bread dough]] for cooking. Alternately, if you have completed [[X Marks the Spot]], you can travel via [[Veos]] to [[Port Piscarilius]], and head west to the [[Kourend Castle Baker's Stall.]] to purchase some bread. Open the door to the jeweller's shop and a beggar will approach, asking for food to feed his starving family. Give him the loaf of bread. When you do, he will change into the Lady of the Lake, who gives you [[Excalibur]] for passing the test. '''You must finish this dialogue or you will need another piece of bread to repeat it.''' {{clear|left}} ===Chaos altar inscription=== {{Map|mtype=pin|3258,3381|align=right|caption=Location of the inscription.|width=200|height=200}} [[File:Chaos altar.png|100px|frameless|left]]Finally, you will need the magic words for the spell. Head to the [[Zamorakian chapel]] in the south-east corner of [[Varrock]], containing a [[chaos altar (Prayer)|chaos altar]]. "Check" the altar to find the words needed: ''Snarthon Candtrick Termanto''. '''Finishing this dialogue is required to progress further.''' ===Breaking the Crystal=== {{Needed|[[Excalibur]], [[black candle]], [[tinderbox]], [[bat bones]]}} [[File:Merlin's Crystal - Thrantax the Mighty.png|thumb|left|220px|Summoning Thrantax.]] Now that you have all the required items and the magic words, return to [[Camelot]], where you will find the magical symbol on the north-east side of the castle's garden, just inside the fence. Light your black candle and '''drop''' the bat bones in the circle ('''DO NOT BURY THEM'''). A demonic spirit named [[Thrantax the Mighty]] will appear, and you will be presented with a sequence of words. The correct incantation is "'''Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'''". If you get it right, the spirit will obey you. :'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' If you recite the wrong phrase, the spirit will attack you, and you will have to get a new black candle and try again. ==Walkthrough==
===Brother Omad===
[[File:Brother Omad chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Brother Omad]] at the [[Ardougne Monastery]] south of [[Ardougne]]. Teleport nearby via [[Ardougne Cloak 1]], [[fairy rings]] code {{fairycode|DJP}}, or [[Fishing Trawler]] [[minigame teleport]] and walking north. He wants you to retrieve a [[child's blanket]] from some thieves found in a secret cave hidden under a ring of stones west of the monastery.
{{Clear|left}}
===Child's blanket===
{{Map|2561,3221|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=The stone circle's location.}}
Head west immediately after exiting the [[Ardougne Monastery]]. East of the [[Battlefield|Gnome Battlefield]] and south-west of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]], there is a perfect circle of grey stones. When inside the ring, a ladder will appear.
[[File:Monk's Friend - Stone circle.png|thumb|200px|left|A ladder mysteriously appears.]]
Climb down the ladder into a large dungeon. Take the first path south into the room at the end, where you'll find the [[child's blanket]] on the table guarded by two level 14 [[Thief|thieves]] and a level 26 [[Head Thief]].

Bring the blanket back to [[Omad]]. He will be pleased because he can sleep now. '''Talk to Omad again''', who is now better and ready to organise a child's birthday party: he just needs [[Brother Cedric]] to return with the wine. '''Ask who he is, and then ask where to find him, or you will be unable to complete the following section.''' He will point the player towards the nearby forest.
{{Clear|left}}
===Brother Cedric===
[[File:Brother Cedric chathead.png|left]]
{{Map|name=Brother Cedric|x=2614|y=3259|r=3|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=Brother Cedric's location.}}
Leave the [[Ardougne Monastery|monastery]] and head directly north to find Brother Cedric south of the [[Ardougne Zoo]]'s camel cage. He's very drunk and needs a [[jug of water]] to sober up. A jug of water can be found in the cooking shop in [[Yanille]] or the general store in [[Port Khazard]]. You cannot use the well next to Cedric to fill up your jug, but you can use the [[bucket]] on the well, then the [[bucket of water]] on a [[jug]]. There is also a sink south of the monastery. Alternatively, you can kill [[imp]]s near Port Khazard for either a full or empty jug.

Give the jug of water to Cedric to sober him up. Now, he needs [[logs]] or a [[plank]] to repair his cart. Cut a log if needed and talk to Cedric again. '''Only''' regular logs work. If you do not have an axe, there are plank spawns in Port Khazard, south-west of the bank chest.  He can now repair his cart and wants you to go back to Brother Omad to tell him he is coming soon.

Go back to [[Brother Omad]], who will finally start the party.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|name=Edmond|2568,3334|r=4|mtype=square|width=220|height=220|align=right|caption=[[Edmond]]'s location.}}
===Infiltrating West Ardougne===
[[File:Edmond chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Needed|[[dwellberries]], 4 [[buckets of water]], a [[spade]], a [[rope]], a [[bucket of milk]], [[chocolate dust]], and [[snape grass]].}}
Talk to [[Edmond]] behind his house, next to the wall surrounding [[West Ardougne]] and north of the [[Ardougne Castle]]. He will mention that he has to find his daughter, Elena; ask him what happened to her, and he'll explain that she's a healer who crossed the wall into plague-stricken [[West Ardougne]] three weeks ago, but hasn't been heard from since. Agree to help him with his plan to get into West Ardougne, and he'll tell you to talk to his wife about protection against the plague.

His wife, [[Alrena]], is inside the house or wandering outside. She'll tell you she can make a [[gas mask]] if you get her some [[dwellberries]]. Give them to her and she'll give you a mask. ''After receiving the first mask, spare masks can be found in the cupboard.'' While in the house, pick up the [[picture]] of [[Elena]].

Talk to Edmond again, and he'll tell you his plan to dig under the wall and get into [[West Ardougne]]. First, you'll need to soften the ground: do this by using four [[buckets of water]] on the [[Dug hole|mud patch]] behind his house, between the [[Cabbage (scenery)|cabbages]] and [[Potato (scenery)|potatoes]]. You can refill buckets with the sink inside if needed.

Once the ground is soft, use the [[spade]] on the softened ground. You'll fall under, and Edmond will follow you down. In the sewer, walk south to find a [[pipe (Plague City)|pipe]] blocked by a [[grill (Plague City)|grill]]. After pulling on it to no avail, use a [[rope]] on the pipe, and talk to Edmond to pull the grill off. Put on your gas mask, and climb inside to enter West Ardougne.
{{Map|name=The Rehnison household|2531,3331|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|height=220|width=220|caption=The Rehnison House}}

===Finding Elena===
[[File:Jethick chathead.png|left|frameless]]
{{Needed|Elena's [[picture]].}}
Once inside [[West Ardougne]], talk to [[Jethick]], found just to the east (in the same plaza). Show him [[Elena]]'s picture and he'll tell you to go check the [[The Rehnison household|Rehnison house]], and give you a [[Book (Plague City)|book]] that he borrowed from them. Go north to the grey house sitting right up against the edge of the wall, as shown on the map to the right. They'll let you in when you mention you have the book. Once inside, talk to [[Martha Rehnison]] or [[Ted Rehnison]], then go upstairs and talk to their daughter, [[Milli Rehnison]], who'll tell you more about Elena's disappearance and whereabouts.

After talking to the family, leave the house and head south past the town square, to the house along the southern wall with a large black "X" on the doors. The house will have a stairwell in the middle going down, and is marked with a black box on the map. Attempt to open the doors and you'll be blocked by the [[mourner]]s, who won't let you in because it's been hit hard by the plague. Tell them that you're looking for a kidnapped girl (you need to select the option to ask again or you can't continue), and they'll tell you that you need permission from [[Bravek]] to enter the house.

{{Clear|left}}

===Getting inside===
[[File:Mourner chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Plague City - Bravek drinks the hangover cure.png|thumb|220px|right|Bravek drinks the cure.]]
{{Needed|[[Hangover cure]] or the ingredients to make it.}}
Go back to the town square and enter the large building on the north side of the [[manhole (West Ardougne)|manhole]]. Ask the [[clerk]] who is through the door, then tell him ''This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!'', and he'll let you inside to see a badly-hungover [[Bravek]].

Talk to Bravek and he'll give you [[a scruffy note]] with a recipe for a [[hangover cure]]. To make it, put the [[chocolate dust]] into the [[bucket of milk]], then add [[snape grass]]'''. Be careful: do not left-click on the chocolate bar or the chocolatey milk, or you will eat/drink them!''' Once made, give the hangover cure to Bravek, and tell him that the mourners won't listen to you. He'll then give you a [[warrant]] granting permission to enter the plague house and search for [[Elena]].

Go to the plague house and try to enter again. The [[mourner]]s will try to stop you, but will be at a loss when given the warrant, giving you a chance to sneak inside. Once inside, search the [[barrel (Plague City)|barrel]] to the west of the staircase to find [[a small key]]. Then, go downstairs to find Elena, unlock the door with the key, and talk to her to release her.

Return to [[Edmond]]'s garden, either by teleporting out, or by climbing down the manhole in the middle of the city and climbing up the [[mud pile (Ardougne Sewers)|mud pile]]. Talk to Edmond to finish the quest.

'''Murder Mystery''' is a quest that investigates the murder of [[Lord Sinclair]]. The culprit is random for each player, so some investigation must be done to determine the murderer. However, there are plenty of clues to be found around the [[Sinclair Mansion]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to any [[Guard (Sinclair Mansion)|guard]] around the [[Sinclair Mansion]], north  of [[Seers' Village]] and [[Camelot]].
|startmap = 2741,3562
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Old man Sinclair has been found dead in his mansion! Unfortunately, the local authorities are having some trouble figuring out who's the guilty party. Maybe the unbiased eye of a passing adventurer will be of help.
|length = Short
|items = * [[Pot]] or [[Pot of flour]]
|recommended = * 16 empty [[inventory]] spaces
* [[Weight-reducing clothing]]
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
Murder Mystery is one of the more unique [[quests]] because the outcome of the quest is random, so there is a reasonable amount of detective work you have to do on your own. However, there are plenty of clues to be found as to who the culprit is.

===Starting out===
{{Map|x=2741|y=3562|r=4|mtype=square|width=250|height=250|align=right|caption=The quest's start point.}}
Head to the [[Sinclair Mansion]] located north to [[Camelot|camelot castle]]. [[Fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|cjr}} is nearby.

Talk to the [[Guard (Sinclair Mansion)|guard]] to activate the quest. Then, enter the house and search the murder scene, which is on the east side of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. There are three things you need to do in this room.

# Inside will be a [[pungent pot]] on a table, which you should pick up.
# There is the [[criminal's dagger]] on the floor, which you should collect.
# Investigate the smashed window to find the [[criminal's thread]].

Go around to the various bedrooms belonging to the suspects to find six silver items, all contained within barrels in each room. (There are four rooms upstairs and two on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}.) Look for:

*[[Anna]]'s [[silver necklace]]
*[[Bob (Sinclair)|Bob]]'s [[silver cup]]
*[[Carol]]'s [[silver bottle]]
*[[David (Murder Mystery)|David]]'s [[silver book]]
*[[Elizabeth (Murder Mystery)|Elizabeth]]'s [[silver needle]]
*[[Frank]]'s [[silver pot (Murder Mystery)|silver pot]]

Now, it's time to get your first piece of evidence. Go to the main entrance of the mansion, and go north-east until you reach the [[Sinclair Guard dog|guard dog]] enclosure. Investigate the sturdy wooden gate for more information.

Next, go to the gardener's shed (the small house on the ground level, west side of the outside of the mansion) and investigate the sacks to find [[flypaper]]. Take seven of these.

Go to the kitchen in the north-west corner of the mansion, and fill your empty [[pot]] with flour. Use it on the criminal's dagger; then, use the dagger on a piece of flypaper to get an [[unknown print]]. Dust each silver item with more flour, and use the flypaper to lift fingerprints from the items; then, compare them to the print of the criminal's dagger you found at the crime scene by using the flypaper pieces on the first flypaper print you got from the dagger.

Once you've got a match, all the silver items are no longer needed and can be safely dropped, except for your proof.

You'll need more than just that for a conviction, though. Go to the entrance of the mansion, and talk to [[Gossip]], and ask him who he thinks is responsible.

[[File:Murder Mystery - Poison Salesman.png|thumb|250px|Talking to the Poison Salesman]]

Next, you need to gather info about the poison. There's a [[Poison Salesman|poison salesman]], who sells it inside of the pub west of the [[bank]] in [[Seers' Village]]. Ask him to whom he sold the poison, and he'll tell you that everyone at the mansion bought some.

Go back to the house and ask the person who had the fingerprints on the criminal's dagger to find out what the poison was used on. Search the item they mention, detailed here:

*Anna - [[Sinclair family compost heap]]
*Bob - [[Sinclair family beehive]] in cow pen
*Carol - [[Sinclair mansion drain]], west of the front door
*David - [[Spiders' nest]], upstairs between the two rooms with three beds each in them
*Elizabeth - [[Sinclair family fountain]]
*Frank - [[Sinclair family crest]], east of the front door

You'll find that the subject was lying and didn't use their poison on what they had said they did.

:'''Note:''' If you wish to keep the silver necklace as a souvenir, drop it before talking to the guard (banking will not work).

Go back and talk to a guard and tell him you know who did it. Use the fingerprints of the person that did it on the unknown fingerprint. Show him the fingerprints, tell him about the poison, and show him the thread from the windowsill, since its colour will be a match to an article of the culprit's clothing. Case closed!

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Nature Spirit''' is a quest that takes place deep in the [[Mort Myre Swamp]]. The nature spirit [[Filliman Tarlock]] needs help restoring the [[Nature Grotto]], his home, to its previous glory.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = After saving the holy man Drezel, he's seeking some assistance again.
This time he has a special request for any adventurous sorts to search for the Druid 'Filliman Tarlock' and brave the terrors that infest the swamp of Mort Myre.

|kills = * 3 [[Ghast]]s ''(level 30)''
|ironman = * {{SCP|Crafting|18|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} to craft a [[silver sickle]] using a [[silver bar]] on a [[furnace]] with a [[sickle mould]] in your inventory. The [[silver bar]] may be purchased from the [[Silver merchant]] in [[Ardougne]].
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Varlamore}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
[[File:Drezel chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Drezel]] in the basement of the [[Paterdomus Temple]] where you left him at the end of [[Priest in Peril]]. Drezel will give you three [[meat pie]]s and three [[apple pie]]s to take to [[Filliman Tarlock]].

Pass through the [[Holy Barrier]] by Drezel, then cross the nearby bridge. Travel south to the gate permitting access to the [[Mort Myre Swamp]].

===Traversing the swamp===
{{Needed|Ghostspeak amulet|recommended=Additional food for low levels (some may be rotted, see below)}}
{{Map|3441,3337|r=8|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Location of the Grotto Tree.}}
[[File:Nature Spirit - Nature Grotto.png|thumb|220px|The Grotto Tree.]]
While in the swamp the player will lose 3 health every 2 minutes to [[swamp decay]]. Additionally [[ghasts]] will attempt to rot your food, though they may often miss. Without any food in your inventory they will instead deal up to 3 [[typeless]] damage per attack. The [[druid pouch]] obtained later during the quest will protect you from ghasts by consuming charges per attack. Do not worry about the food given by Drezel being rotted as you won't actually end up giving Filliman the food. You may considering banking this food in [[Canifis]] before entering the swamp to avoid it rotting if you have more inexpensive food to use.

You must enter the [[Mort Myre Swamp]] through the gate, or Filliman will not appear. Head south along the west river until you see the grotto tree. Attempt to jump across the [[Bridge (Nature Grotto)|broken bridge]] to the grotto. There is a chance to fail this jump. '''Failing to jump across will cause the player to take between 1 and 7 damage and can be lethal.''' If the jump fails, the player will still swim to the grotto regardless.

Once on the island, the player will be safe from both swamp decay and ghasts. Attempt to enter the grotto via the small black hole with an "Enter" option, and the ghost of [[Filliman Tarlock]] will appear.

Equip your [[amulet of ghostspeak]] to speak to him. He won't believe that he's dead, so take the [[washing bowl]] off the nearby [[bench (Nature Grotto)|bench]] to find a [[mirror]] underneath. Use the mirror on Filliman to convince him. After this, he will tell you to find his [[Journal (Filliman Tarlock)|journal]]. Search the [[Grotto tree]] to get it and give it to him.

Ask him how you can help, and Filliman will mention that the journal details the requirements for him to complete his transformation into a Nature Spirit. He will give you a [[Druidic spell|spell scroll]].

===Blessings===
{{Needed|Druidic spell (given to you by Filliman), a [[Silver sickle]], and your ghost speak amulet|recommended=Additional food to prevent the mushroom from being rotted in this section}}
[[File:Nature Spirit - Drezel's blessing.gif|thumb|170px|[[Drezel]] blesses the player.]]

Return to [[Drezel]] and ask him to bless you. For the next step you will need to use [[Prayer]] points. If you need to recharge them, there is an [[altar]] on the [[Paterdomus Temple]]'s main floor.

Once blessed by Drezel, return to the swamp and look for any [[rotting log]]. Cast the [[druidic spell]] next to it to make a mushroom grow. The [[druidic spell]] will transform into [[a used spell]]; '''do not''' drop it as you will need it later. Pick up the mushroom and show it to [[Filliman]]. If a Ghast turns your mushroom rotten, go back to the grotto to ask for another [[Bloom]] scroll.

:'''Note:''' Multiple spells cards may be obtained from Filliman utilising the [[drop trick]]. This can be used to avoid the need to use prayer in the next section.

[[File:Nature Spirit - Performing the nature spirit ritual.gif|thumb|220px|[[Filliman]] performs the transformation ritual.]]

At Filliman's grotto, '''use''' (don't drop) the mushroom on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Brown|light-brown (western) stone]], and the used spell card on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Grey|grey stone]]. Summon Filliman again if needed by trying to enter his grotto, '''then, while standing on the [[stone (Nature Spirit)#Orange|orange stone]]''', tell Filliman you think that you have solved the puzzle. Filliman will complete half of his transformation and ask you to come inside the [[Nature Grotto|grotto]].

[[File:Nature spirit - Blessing sickle.gif|thumb|170px|[[Filliman]] blesses the player's silver sickle.]]

Go inside, and search the grotto in the middle of the cave. Filliman will turn into a Nature Spirit, then ask you to get a [[Silver sickle]]. Talk to him again and Filliman will bless the sickle, turning it into a [[Silver sickle (b)]]. After giving you a [[Druid pouch]], he will then ask you to kill three [[ghast]]s.

===Killing the ghasts===
{{Needed|A [[weapon]], [[Ghostspeak amulet]], [[druid pouch]], and [[prayer potions]] for players with low [[Prayer]]}}
[[File:Ghast dying.gif|thumb|120px|The [[ghast]] is freed after it is killed.]]

Go into the swamp with the blessed silver sickle, and operate it to cast [[Bloom]] while standing next to logs, bushes, and twigs. Each cast costs 1-6 [[Prayer points]] and allows you to harvest nearby [[Mort myre pear|pears]], [[Mort myre fungi|fungi]], and [[Mort myre stem|stems]].

Add at least three pears, fungi, or stems to your druid pouch by clicking "Fill" while three of them are in your inventory.

When you use the druid pouch on the level 30 ghasts, they'll become visible, and one charge will be deducted from your druid pouch. Kill three of them (you may use any weapon).

:'''Note:''' If you get a message when using the druid pouch saying "You've not been told how to use this item yet", ensure you've finished the dialogue with Filliman explaining how to use it.

Enter the grotto tree, then search the grotto and speak with the Nature Spirit to complete the quest.

:{{Color|red|Warning:}} Any items dropped before speaking with the Nature Spirit will be lost in the "old" grotto upon completion of the quest. 

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip:''' Before leaving, pray at the [[Altar of nature]] within the Grotto to complete an easy task for the [[Morytania Diary]].

==Details==

Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Varlamore}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>

==Walkthrough==
===The Paterdomus priest===
{{map|3410,3494|zoom=3|align=right|caption=Location of the Temple and Dungeon Entrance to the north.}}
{{Needed|[[Combat equipment]]|recommended=[[Varrock teleport]]}}
Talk to [[King Roald]] in the south-easternmost room of the [[Varrock Palace]] near the main entrance, and ask him for a quest. He will ask the player if they are aware of the [[Paterdomus Temple]], which guards [[Misthalin]] from the only passage into the deadly vampyre-infested lands of [[Morytania]]. After the player responds that they've heard of it, the King will tell them that it has been some days since he heard from [[Drezel]], the priest who lives there. He wants the player to check in on them.

[[File:Paterdomus Temple.png|thumb|220px|The entrance to the temple.]]
The [[Paterdomus Temple|temple]] is located north-east of [[Varrock]]. After exiting Varrock through the eastern entrance, head north along the path, continuing past the [[Earth Altar]] through the gate to the east. Follow the path all the way to the temple, then attempt to open the door. A mysterious voice will ask who you are and what you want. Tell them King Roald sent you to check on Drezel. After some panicked muttering, a second voice will introduce themselves as Drevil, before clarifying that they meant Drezel. They will then ask for a favour; a horrible big dog-like thing has moved into the mausoleum outside, and they want the player to get rid of it.

===The dungeon===
[[File:Temple_Guardian_safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|Safespotting the Temple Guardian.]]

Climb down the trapdoor north of the temple, then kill the unaggressive level 30 [[temple guardian]], which may be [[safespotted]] with ranged, or [[flinched]] using melee. You cannot use [[Magic]]. To trap the guardian, simply move one square east after coming down the ladder, and drag the dog over by using ranged attacks, or by attacking with melee and then running back to the same square.

:'''Note:''' If using [[rings of recoil]], 1 damage must be dealt by the player for the kill to register.

===Returning to King Roald===
Return to King Roald in the [[Varrock Palace]]. After telling him you killed the dog in the mausoleum, King Roald becomes enraged, and explains that the [[Temple guardian|dog]] was protecting the mausoleum from sabotage, and that the whole of [[Misthalin]] is now at risk. He instructs you to go back and fix it right away.

Before returning, if you don't yet have a bucket, go up the nearby stairs and grab one from the bedroom in the north eastern corner. Alternatively you can buy one from the general store to the south of the palace.

===Back to the temple===
{{Needed|50 Unnoted [[Rune essence|rune]] or [[pure essence]], an empty [[bucket]], [[combat]] [[equipment]] and 1 free [[inventory]] space|recommended=[[Essence pouch]]es and [[Varrock teleport]]s}}
[[File:Monk_of_zamorak_safespot.png|thumb|left|220px|Safespotting the Monk of Zamorak.]]
Return to the temple and enter it. Kill the '''hooded''' level 30 [[Monk of Zamorak (Paterdomus)|Monk of Zamorak]] to get a [[golden key]]. Only the level 30 monk will drop the key. The monk attacks with magic, and can be trapped in-between the pews by standing south of the pew, to be safespotted with ranged or magic. They can also be flinched with the same method.

:'''Note:''' If using [[rings of recoil]], 1 damage must be dealt by the player to receive the key.

After receiving the key, climb up the stairs in the north-east corner of the room, then climb up the ladder of the south west corner of the room to reach the top floor. Talk to [[Drezel]] through the bars. He will explain that Zamorakians have attacked the temple, intending to desecrate the blessings placed upon the holy River Salve by the [[Seven Priestly Warriors]] and leave Misthalin defenceless against the vampyres of Morytania. Ask what to do, and he will explain that you need to find the key to unlock his cell and a way to deal with the vampyre trapped in the nearby coffin. As a descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the river, it may be awoken by the familiar scent of his blood. If you choose to speak to him again, he will suggest that the Zamorakians may have hidden the right key somewhere, as the golden key you retrieved does not fit the gate.

Next, go back down the trap door into the mausoleum. With the golden key in the inventory, the player can now unlock the gate to the south. Through the gate is a room with seven [[monument]]s and a [[Well (Paterdomus)|well]]. Study the monuments until you find the one that holds an [[iron key]], then use the golden key on it to swap the two. After obtaining the iron key, use your empty [[bucket]] on the nearby well to fill it with [[murky water]].

:'''Note''': The other monuments hold golden items which may be obtained once as souvenirs by swapping them with the regular versions. The items that may be swapped are a [[pot]], [[feather]], [[candle]], [[tinderbox]], [[needle]], and [[hammer]]. This can no longer be done after Drezel moves to the mausoleum in the following steps.'''

[[File:Priest in Peril - Blessing the coffin.png|thumb|250px|The player pours the bucket of blessed water on the coffin, trapping the vampyre within.]]
Return to the top floor of the temple, and use the iron key on the cell door. Enter the cell and talk to [[Drezel]], who will bless the murky water for you. Use the [[blessed water]] on the [[Coffin (Priest in Peril)|coffin]] just outside of the cell to seal the vampyre within it. Talk to [[Drezel]] again and he will ask the player to meet him in the mausoleum, in order to help revert the damage that the Zamorakians have done.

Return to the dungeon and proceed through the gate located in the north-east corner of the monument room. Speak to [[Drezel]], who will tell the player that the Zamorakians have used a potion to pollute the River Salve. While he focuses on reinforcing the barrier between Morytania and Misthalin, he wants the player to help soak up the evil magic that the potion has released into the river. To do this, he needs 50 '''unnoted''' rune essence.

If you need to, you can give him a mixture of both [[rune essence|rune]] and [[pure essence]]. Players with essence pouches can bring all 50 essence in a single trip if desired. If you don't have an [[essence pouch]], make multiple trips as needed.

After bringing him all of the rune essence, he will thank the player and give them a [[Wolfbane]] dagger, explaining that it has been passed down through his family for generations and is imbued with the power of [[Saradomin]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Note:''' To unlock access to [[Morytania]], you must ask Drezel if you can now pass through the barrier, and wait until he has blessed you.

Once you are at [[Iban]]'s temple (where you encounter him during Underground Pass), go in and talk to [[Koftik]] if you require food. Go into the forest just a little bit and wait for an elf named [[Idris]] to spawn and start a dialogue with you. '''This may take a little while. If he spawns but does not talk to you, hop worlds and try again'''. He will question why you are here, but he is slain by [[Essyllt]] and [[Morvran]] before he has the chance to finish. They will tell you to talk to [[Lord Iorwerth]], who can be found at the camp in the north-west corner of the forest. Before proceeding with the quest, here is a detailed map of [[Tirannwn]]: [[File:Isafdar map.png|600px|centre]] As you navigate the forest, you will encounter four different obstacles: *[[Dense forest]]: You will learn how to navigate this obstacle after speaking to an [[Elf Tracker]] later in the quest. 56 [[Agility]] is required to push through the dense forest, though this is not required to return back to the starting point of this obstacle (e.g., returning from [[Tyras Camp]] to the forest). This obstacle cannot be failed. '''Note:''' Players under level 56 Agility can use the fact that most dense forests only have an Agility requirement one way through the forest. It is advised to attempt passing through the forest before taking a bite or sip from your boosting item. *[[Leaves (trap)|Leaf trap]]: This obstacle is a pitfall that appears as a circle of leaves on the ground. '''Click "Jump Over" on the side of the trap that is closest to where you are standing.''' If you ignore or fail the trap, you will fall through the leaves and lose 15 [[HP]]. *[[Tripwire]]: You will see two rocks connected by a thin wire with four small crossbows pointing at them. Right click between the rocks to step over the tripwire. If you ignore or fail the trap, you will lose 10 [[HP]] and be [[poison]]ed, starting at 2 HP. *[[Sticks (trap)|Stick trap]]: This obstacle appears as some sticks on the ground. Click "Pass" on the obstacle. If you ignore or fail the trap, you will lose 8 [[HP]]. If you stand in front of the trap by exactly one square, and repeatedly 'spam'-click the trap until your character moves over, you will negate any damage and never fail this trap, no matter your Agility level. If you stop clicking for just one tick, your character will attempt to walk, and may fail and take damage! So make sure to keep clicking until your characters moves automatically. === Getting through the forest=== Make your way to the [[Iorwerth Camp|Elf Camp]] in the north-west corner. See the map above for reference. Along the way you can kill and cook [[Rabbit|rabbits]] for food if needed. *From the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] exit, go west and take the south split in the path to avoid the stick trap. * Keep going west until you see a leaf trap (pitfall) to the south. Jump over it. *Keep going south until you reach two small pools of water. Go west and cross the stick trap. *Go up the north-west path and jump over the leaf trap. Keep going north and cross the log balance (Level 45 Agility is required) to reach the camp. At the camp, speak with [[Lord Iorwerth]]. He will tell you to talk to his tracker after you tell him that [[King Lathas]] sent you. Go back down the path you took to reach the camp, but go south when you reach the stick trap. The [[Elf Tracker]] is at a small camp just north of the [[Poison Waste]]. He will not believe what you say since you are a human, so return to [[Lord Iorwerth]] to get a [[crystal pendant]]. Note that if you wish to keep the pendant as a souvenir, it '''must''' be [[drop trick]]ed every time you talk to Lord Iorwerth from now on, as well as when completing the quest by talking to [[King Lathas]] - otherwise it will be removed from your inventory or bank. Talk to the tracker again with the pendant in your possession. He will tell you to find the [[Tyras Camp]]. [[File:Tyras guard safespot.png|thumb|220px|A safespot is available to fight the Tyras guard.]] Click "Follow" on the footprints leading into the dense forest to the west. You will receive a message telling you that you are unable to follow the footprints. Return to the tracker and tell him. You will now be able to climb through dense forest if you have 56 [[Agility]]. Climb through the dense forest just west of the tracker and a level 110 [[Tyras guard]] will attack you, equipped with a [[steel halberd]]. Despite having a halberd, he does not have a 2-square attack range. You can use the mushrooms as a safespot or use [[Protect from Melee]] to make the fight easier ([[Prayer flicking]] is an option as he has a slow attack speed). If you take too long in killing him, he will despawn, and you will have to try to summon him again, or kill the guard by the entrance to the Tyras camp instead. This alternative guard does not despawn, but he does in fact have a 2-square attack range, and his safe spot is more difficult. Lure him to the clump of rocks directly north-east of the dense forest, trap him in the small hollow, and walk east out of his range. He will try to back away from you when you attack from outside his range, but will be caught in the rocks on his west and south. After you have killed one of these guards, proceed to the Tyras Camp, stepping over the tripwire to the north-west if you killed the first guard. Climb through the dense forest to the north and then go west. You will find [[Tyras Camp]] past the dense forest that is south of the [[catapult]]. If you killed the second guard, he may respawn if you do not enter the dense forest quickly enough but he will not attack you after you have killed him. Talk to [[General Hining]]. He will tell you that you can't see King Tyras. You can buy bread from the general store if you are low on food, but leave one space available for the [[Big Book of Bangs]], which will be given by Lord Iorwerth upon returning to him. Go back to the Elf Tracker, then talk to [[Lord Iorwerth]] '''(remember to drop the [[crystal pendant]] before talking to Iowerth if you are keeping it)'''. ===Getting the materials=== [[Lord Iorwerth]] will give you the [[Big Book of Bangs]]. '''Don't drop this book''' - you need it when in [[Rimmington]] later. Talk to Lord Iorwerth and ask him about all the items. In order to build the explosive, you will need a [[barrel of coal tar]], [[sulphur]], and [[limestone]]. Here is how to gather the materials: [[File:Regicide - Coal tar location.png|thumb|217x217px|The location to obtain the coal tar.]] #Take at least three [[barrel]]s from the Iorwerth camp because you can lose your coal tar when attempting to make the [[barrel of naphtha]]. Another barrel of naphtha will be required for the [[Mourning's End Part I]] quest, so extra barrels now will save time later. Two barrel spawns can be found in the north-east tent. Go back to the [[Elf Tracker]]. Go to the poison waste swamp south of the tracker and fill all your barrels with coal tar. See the image for where to obtain it. The target tile looks no different from the neighbouring grey swamp tiles, but has a "Take Coal Tar" option when hovered over. #Gather some of the [[sulphur]] from beside the poison waste swamp. You will only need one unless you lose the bomb. #If you wish to mine [[limestone]] in the forest, go east of the Iorwerth camp and through the dense forest, and north-east past the gates of [[Prifddinas]]. Find some [[limestone rock]]s and mine one piece of limestone. However, if low on inventory space, it may be more convenient to buy, or mine the limestone later at the [[Limestone Mine]] by the [[Odd Old Man]]. Make '''sure''' you have the [[Big Book of Bangs]], '''at least one [[barrel of coal tar]]''', and some [[sulphur]]. After this, it is safe to teleport out of Isafdar. ===Making the barrel of naphtha=== :'''Note:''' If you are planning to do [[Mourning's End Part I]], you may make an extra [[barrel of naphtha]] (''not'' a completed [[Barrel Bomb]]) and keep it in the bank. {{Needed|The [[Big Book of Bangs]], the [[barrel of coal tar|barrels of coal tar]] and at least 6-9 [[coal]] per barrel. Noted coal can be unnoted at [[Phials]] for 5 coins per coal or use the [[Corsair Cove]] bank.}} Go to [[East Ardougne]] and speak with [[Elena]], who will tell you to see the [[Chemist]] in [[Rimmington]]. Talk to the Chemist about the quest, and he will give you permission to use the distiller. Now, use a barrel of coal tar on the large distiller outside.[[File:Regicide_-_Distilling_naphtha.png|thumb|220x220px|The interface when making a barrel of naphtha.]] The barrel is only used to access the machine; as long as you leave the window open and have enough coal you can still do the distilling. All you need to do here is to get the green bar filled. You can configure the machine ''before'' using any coal. The valves can be clicked on their left side or their right side to control what side they go to. The idea of using this distiller is to keep pressure stable on its green area (this is the first segment that the needle reaches, the following one being red) and keep the heat on the green area (tips below) as long as possible while adding coal, but there is tolerance for mistakes. The pressure valve has 3 positions: Closed, controlled, and released (the last one resets pressure to 0, remember you need some pressure to make the naphtha), it is initially closed (handle on the left side). The tar regulator has 3 positions as well: Closed, intake, and afterburner, it is also initially closed and once you put it to intake (handle at the top) pressure will start going up. Let the pressure go up to the green area, but pay attention to the heat level. ''Add coal as needed, optimally to maintain the heat gauge in the green zone, but it could be played more safely by keeping it well below overheating.'' '''A very easy way to do this is:''' # Start by using the barrel of coal tar on the Fractionalising still. # Turn the valve on the right all the way to the third tick (all the way to the right). #Wait for the pressure gauge to land in the green zone. #Quickly turn the valve on the left to the second tick (in the middle) to halt the pressure in the green zone. If it landed in the red zone, you could turn the valve right to relieve some pressure, then back to the middle. #'''The valves never need to be touched again, and the pressure gauge can be ignored.''' # Add 2 coal, and then 1 additional coal whenever the heat gauge falls too low (below, or counterclockwise from, the green zone). '''Don't spam click the "add coal" button. If you add too much at once, it is likely to overheat''' and you will have to restart, but this does not make you lose your barrel of coal tar. Simply add more coal to start the process again. Optimally, the process is fast and may only likely use 6-9 coal. The bar on the bottom should start turning green. When it is full, stop adding coal and close the window to replace your empty barrel with a [[barrel of naphtha]]. To prevent confusion, note that the barrel of naphtha in your inventory looks almost identical to an empty barrel. ===Making the bomb=== *Limestone can be bought on the Grand Exchange, or can be mined on the path to [[Paterdomus]], north-east of [[Varrock]]. The coal, gloves, pestle and mortar, pickaxe, and combat gear no longer need to be brought. Kill a [[rabbit]] and cook it on any fire. If you did not bring an [[axe]], there are lit fires in the [[Iorwerth Camp|Elven Camp]], as well as in [[Zul-Andra]] south of Tyras Camp. Then, go to the catapult outside the [[Tyras Camp]]. Talk to the guard, and give him some rabbit meat to distract him. Then, use the bomb on the catapult - you will need your tinderbox for this. (If you forgot your tinderbox, you can buy one from the General Store in the camp). You will see a cutscene of your character loading the barrel onto the catapult and launching it at [[King Tyras]]' camp, where it [[Burning tent (Regicide)|explodes on his tent]]. '''Monkey Madness I''' is the fourth quest in the [[gnome quest series]], and one of the most well-known quests in ''RuneScape.'' The quest brings the player to [[Ape Atoll]], an island inhabited by civilised but unfriendly and high-level [[monkey]]s, in order to help [[Narnode Shareen]] track down his missing [[10th Squad]] military unit.

A grandmaster-difficulty sequel to the quest called [[Monkey Madness II]] was released on [[6 May]] [[2016]].

==Introduction ==
[[File:Monkey Madness I - Ape Atoll map.png|thumb|400px|All the routes you'll need to take in the quest.]]

[[Ape Atoll]] is one of the most dangerous areas in the game. All native creatures other than the level 5 [[Bird|birds]] will be [[aggressive]] towards you, regardless of your [[combat level]], whenever you're not wearing the [[monkey greegree]] (made later in the quest). Players can hug the coasts of Ape Atoll when moving to avoid the poisonous snakes and spiders; some snakes may still be encountered this way, but players can simply wait for them to move.

When going to the island, make sure to bring plenty of [[food]], [[Antipoison|antipoison potions]], and an emergency [[teleport]], in addition to any other required items. Switching off [[Auto Retaliate|auto retaliate]] and utilising [[protection prayers]] will greatly improve your chances of survival.

At any point, you can teleport or flee from [[Ape Atoll]] to restock items without losing your progress. To leave the island by boat, simply talk to [[Lumdo]] in the landing area to go from Ape Atoll back to [[Crash Island]], and then talk to [[Waydar]] on Crash Island to go back to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]]. To resume the quest, talk to [[Daero]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Grand Tree]] to go back to the hangar, talk to Waydar in the hangar to go back to Crash Island, and finally, talk to Lumdo on Crash Island to return to Ape Atoll.

== Monkey Business ==
{{Needed|three free inventory spaces|recommended=some high-healing [[food]], a form of [[Poison#Curing poison|poison protection]], a [[lockpick]], and a [[knife]] (to prevent the player from needing to bank by cutting the island's [[Pineapple plant|pineapple]] plants for food)}}

=== Chapter 1 ===
{{Listen
|title = [[New Chapter (Monkey Madness)|New Chapter]]

'''"In which our hero finds themself drawn back into Glough's web of deception and deceit."'''[[File:King Narnode Shareen chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[King Narnode Shareen]] in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. He will tell you to investigate [[Glough]]'s old shipyard for any trace of the missing 10th Squad, and will give you the [[gnome royal seal]]. Bring this to [[Karamja]] (the ''"Gandius"'' option on the [[glider]] at the top of the [[Grand Tree]] will bring you nearby). ''If you do not have [[monkey bones]] (or a [[monkey corpse]]), kill a monkey while on Karamja to obtain some.''

'''Note: If you leave the quest to do something else, you will need the gnome royal seal to get into the shipyard'''

After arriving, enter the [[Shipyard (Karamja)|shipyard]] north of the glider landing site and speak with [[G.L.O. Caranock]], a gnome officer for the shipyard. He can be found in the building in the southern area, near the fence. He will act very suspiciously when spoken to, and advise you to return to the king.

Return to King Narnode, and he will give you [[Narnode's orders]] and tell you to speak to [[Daero]], the new head tree guardian. Daero can be found on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the Grand Tree, near [[Blurberry Bar]]. Go through all the chat options with Daero, and ensure you're ready for surviving Ape Atoll; when you're ready, tell him you're prepared to leave. He will then blindfold you and take you to an [[Underground Military Glider Hangar|underground hangar]]. 

Talk to Daero in the hangar and he will introduce you to [[Waydar]], a gnome pilot. Waydar will task you with solving a "reinitialisation" puzzle, which is similar to the [[puzzle box]]es from [[Treasure Trails]]. If you have done these puzzles before, the sliding puzzle will be easy to complete; if not, see below for the solution, or bring 200,000 [[coins]] and go to [[Glough]], who resides in the same area he did during the [[Grand Tree]] quest. 

==== Waydar's puzzle ====
Begin solving the puzzle by clicking on the panel to the south-east by the southern glider. Players can take some [[spare controls]] from the nearby [[crate (Spare controls)|crate]] to view the solution, or simply consult the image below.

[[File:Monkey Madness I - Spare controls.png|thumb|220px|The solution to the reinitialisation puzzle.]]

Solve the sliding puzzle as follows (with the piece numbers counting from the top left corner, moving left to right):

{{Checklist|
* Manoeuvre pieces 1, 2, and 3 into their proper positions in the upper left corner.
* Position piece 4 in the upper right corner.
* Position piece 5 under piece 4 (shuffle pieces 4 and 5 around with some others if they are not in the right order).
* Slide piece 4 to the left and piece 5 up; the first row will now be done.
* Repeat this process with second and then third rows, leaving the completed rows intact.
* With rows 1-3 completed, the puzzle should now be solved in terms of 2-piece high columns.
* Position pieces 16 and 21 next to each other, in that order, on the right-hand side of the bottom row. Slide the remaining tiles clockwise to put them in place.
* Repeat this process with pieces 17 and 22, then with pieces 18 and 23.
* Pieces 19, 20, and 24 should now be easily moved to their correct places.
}}

After completing the puzzle, talk to Daero, and then Waydar. The two of you will depart and then land on the aptly named [[Crash Island]], where the 10th Squad also crashed earlier. Ask the nearby sailor [[Lumdo]] to bring you to [[Ape Atoll]], and he will refuse due to conflicting orders from his sergeant, [[Garkor]]; since Lumdo says he will not take orders from you, talk to Waydar again instead (watch out for poisonous [[Scorpion|scorpions]] just to his left, and '''do not''' click "Travel", as this will bring you back to the Grand Tree). After speaking with Waydar, speak with Lumdo once more, and he will now agree to take you to Ape Atoll.

Do not click the 'X' to close the story tablet that shows up after this conversation or it will cancel the subsequent cut-scene and you'll have to go through the chat option again.

===Chapter 2===
[[File:Monkey Madness I - Jail map.png|thumb|230px|The layout of the jail.]]
'''"In which our hero finds themselves engaging in severe quantities of monkey business."'''

====First Contact====
[[File:Aberab chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Once on the Atoll, start going west, sticking to the southern coastline until you reach a [[mahogany]] tree. From here, run north, avoiding the poisonous [[snake]]s, [[scorpion]]s, and [[Jungle spider (Ape Atoll)|jungle spider]]s. If you have the level to use it, activate [[Protect from Missiles]] as you travel north, as a volley of poisoned arrows will start pelting you as you come closer to the Ape Atoll gate. Once you get close enough to the entrance, you will be knocked out and placed in a prison.

After waking up, you will find yourself in a cell guarded by [[Trefaji]] and [[Aberab]], two gorilla guards. Speak to [[Lumo]], one of the captured 10th Squad members, and then prepare to make your escape.

==== Prison Break ====
{{Map:Monkey Mapness}}Throughout this section and any time you are re-jailed, you will need to stay one square away from the northern cell wall (near the patrolling guards' path) if the guards are in front of it. If you're in their range, they will punch you for 10-20 damage. The guards follow a path, which is as follows: one of the guards will patrol the area twice, walking the length of the prison each time, and then leave to rotate shifts. Use the time that the guard moves '''away''' from your [[Jail Door (Ape Atoll)|jail door]] to pick the lock. Once out, as the patrolling guard is walking out to switch with the one on standby, '''walk behind him to reach the exit.''' Be prepared to make several attempts.

After successfully making it out of the building, travel north of the jail and then east to find [[Karam]], an assassin and member of the 10th Squad. Karam can be found in the bushes near the crafting shop ([[File:Crafting shop icon.png]]); he is mostly translucent and he can be difficult to spot, so look carefully. After finding him, speak with him to learn about the gnome mage [[Zooknock]].

Refer to the map to the right for relevant locations during the quest. Be wary of all '''yellow''' dots, as they represent poisonous enemies (scorpions, snakes, and spiders), as well as aggressive monkey archers. When you are in the grass, the [[monkey archer]]s do not fire, but it's still a good idea to activate [[Protect from Missiles]] as a precaution.

Once you're ready, travel south, past the large door, while staying in the tall jungle grass. Past the door, go around the castle anti-clockwise until you're at the southern end, and from here, run south-east, until you are between a white building and the castle. To the east of that building is [[Garkor]], the Sergeant of the 10th Squad. Speak with him, and make sure to get all the way through the dialogue to the point where he tells you to go meet [[Zooknock]] in person.

==== Supply Crates ====
[[File:Monkey dentures detail.png|left|frameless|width=65x65]]Sprint west through the grass with Protect from Missiles on. Continue west (south of the buildings) in the grass until you reach the doorway to your north, marked on the map image above. Walk through the door to enter an enclosed area with a sleeping monkey guard, a [[Crate (banana)|banana crate]], and a [[Crate (monkey dentures)|dentures crate]].

When inside this house, '''stay on the dark brown ground along the walls''', or you'll risk being sent back to jail. The spiders inside are poisonous, but their poison only hits 1 damage, so it might be helpful to save your anti-poisons for later in the quest. There are bananas in the south-western crates next to the ladder if the player needs a source of food. 

From the entrance, head east and then north, and search the [[Crate (monkey dentures)|stacked crates]] towards the middle of the room to acquire [[monkey dentures]]. The sleeping guard is a non-threat so long as you don't talk to him; otherwise, he will call for guards. 

After you have the dentures, search the [[Crate_(Temple_of_Marimbo_Dungeon_entrance)|south-easternmost crate]] and a prompt will appear, asking if you're ready to enter the area below. You will take 32.9% of your current hitpoints as fall damage if you drop down into the cavern when entering, so heal up if necessary before attempting it to avoid dying to the poisonous spiders. Your [[Agility]] level has a chance to negate this damage, so a [[summer pie]] or other Agility boost may help avoid fall damage during this section.

Once inside the cavern, travel to the '''north-west''' part of the area and search the [[Crate (m'amulet mould)|crates]] to acquire the [[m'amulet mould]]. At this point, if you need to resupply, you can exit the city by going to the south-east corner of [[Marim]], running past the guards and the gravedigger, and climbing up the ladder. After climbing up, jump off the bridge, and go back to the boat to [[Crash Island]]. You can also teleport out.{{clear}}[[File:Monkey Madness I - M'amulet mould location.png|thumb|230px|The location of the M'amulet moulds.]]

====The Light at the End of the Tunnel====
{{Needed|the [[monkey dentures]], the [[m'amulet mould]], and a [[gold bar]]|recommended=1-2 [[antipoison]] potions, 4+ [[energy potion|energy]], or [[Stamina potion|stamina potions]] (or other energy-restoring items such as the [[Explorer's ring 1|explorer's ring]]), 4+ [[prayer potion]]s, some [[food]], a [[plank]] (not necessary if traversing the traps correctly, but can be obtained during the quest anyway), and a [[one-click teleport]]}}

''Note: [[Strange fruit]] are handy for this section as they also cure poison. You will spend about 220% total run energy to traverse to the end of the tunnel at minimum weight, with no energy conserving mechanics; bring enough energy restore to accommodate.'' 

It is '''highly recommended''' to teleport out and bank at this point. This section involves running past dozens of accurate [[Monkey Zombie|monkey zombies]] and [[Skeleton (Ape Atoll)|gorilla skeletons]] which can hit up to 7 and 12 respectively, all while inside a long and tight multicombat tunnel. [[File:ironman chat badge.png]] [[Ironmen]] or other accounts who don't have access to [[energy potion|energy]] or [[prayer potions]] are advised to use other [[Prayer items|prayer-boosting items]], in order to reduce prayer drain. Refer to the table below for the various threats faced throughout the dungeon.
