Even with consistent running, it will take at least three minutes of running to navigate the dungeon. Be prepared to drink your prayer and energy restoring potions, as well as food, when necessary.

At the end of the tunnel, you will find the gnomes [[Zooknock]], [[Waymottin]] and [[Bunkwicket]]. Talk to Zooknock, and then use your [[m'amulet mould]], [[gold bar]], and [[monkey dentures]] on him and speak to him again. '''Make sure he gives you an [[enchanted bar]] before leaving the tunnel'''. Additionally, '''do not to use the m'amulet mould on Zooknock when you already have the enchanted bar''', as he will keep the mould and you will have to obtain another. Teleport out, and bank if necessary. If you have not gone through all the dialogue with Garkor you will not be able to use the items on him.{{clear}}

====Amulet of Monkeyspeak====
{{Needed|the [[enchanted bar]], the [[m'amulet mould]], a [[ball of wool]], [[monkey corpse]] OR regular [[monkey bones]], and five free inventory slots for the bananas|recommended=1-2 [[antipoison]] potions, a one-click teleport, and some food.}}

'''''Note''': If you are going to do [[Recipe for Disaster]], bring a ranged or magic weapon to kill a monkey guard and archer to save time later. Low level Ironmen can use rune spear (kp) from Tai Bwo Wannai Trio if the healing is too much to handle.''
[[File:Zombie monkey (item) detail.png|left|frameless|width=85x85]]
After restocking, return to [[Ape Atoll]] and continue north-west until you are placed in the jail cell again. Escape the cell as before, then travel east towards the temple.

You must now descend through the [[trapdoor (Temple of Marimbo)|trapdoor]] to the east in the temple (see map). Activate [[Protect from Melee]] before entering the temple to block attacks from the powerful [[monkey guards]]. 

Most of the guards can simply be run through, but the ones with beards near the trapdoor will act as walls, trapping you if they surround you. The easiest method to get past the bearded gorillas is to go upstairs, and then climb down the ladder on the east side to get close to the trapdoor. If you choose to walk to the ladder directly, make sure to wait until the guards walk away; players can hide in the north-east corner of the temple until there is enough room to descend. If you're surrounded by guards and can't move, teleport out immediately; if you're trapped near the ladder, go up the stairs and hop worlds. Note that the ladder near the trap door can only be climbed up from the EAST side.
[[File:Wall of flame.png|thumb|width=429x429|The wall of flame.]]
Go down the trapdoor while still praying against melee. Ignore the [[monkey zombie]]s (or kill one and pick up the bones if you want to do [[Recipe for Disaster]] later), and swiftly use the [[enchanted bar]] on the nearby [[wall of flame]]s to make an unstrung [[M'speak amulet (unstrung)|monkey amulet]]. Either travel back up the ladder or find a [[safespot]] to get away from the foes, and use the [[ball of wool]] with the unstrung amulet to create the full [[m'speak amulet]]. Be aware that if you ascend the ladder, you will be attacked and can be trapped as before, so ensure Protect from Melee is active.

====A Monkey's Uncle====
[[File:Monkey talisman detail.png|left|frameless|width=85x85]]
Head to the building west of the jail, making sure to sneak through the grass. You'll see a banana garden that has a [[Monkey Child]] in it, which is being patrolled by [[The Monkey's Aunt]]. The aunt follows a predetermined path, which loops around the wooden house by the garden; do not enter the garden when the monkey's aunt is present, or she will call for guards to arrest you. Note that if you're caught, you can sometimes escape without being arrested by quickly climbing up the ladder in the building nearby before the monkeys reach you. Do not speak to [[The Monkey's Uncle]] upstairs, as he will also call the guards. You can use the abandoned building next to the banana garden to quickly access the garden, as it has a connecting corridor out of sight.

Wait for the aunt to walk away, then speak to the monkey child, and tell him that you are his uncle. After he reveals that he is supposed to collect 20 [[bananas]], search and pick five bananas from the nearby trees. The monkey cannot count, so you do not necessarily need 20, as long as you give him at least 5. Give him the bananas, then wait for a few moments in the corridor, and return to the monkey child when the aunt is away. Ask the child to lend you his [[monkey talisman]].

=====Multiple talismans=====
You can obtain more than one talisman without dropping your current ones, so be sure to get an additional talisman for each [[greegree]] you want (four in total are needed for all quests; see below). You will need to speak to the monkey child again for each one, telling him you have lost the talisman, which will cause him to cry. Waiting for the aunt to pass by the child again will make the monkey child have another talisman available; Alternatively, you can switch worlds to potentially make the process go faster. If you talk to the child again before the aunt has passed by, you will get the message "The monkey child is too busy crying..."

Note that after you make your first greegree, talismans can be purchased from [[Tutab's Magical Market]] for 1000 [[coins]]. Tutab will not open his shop unless you are in monkey form.

=====Multiple greegrees=====
'''Note:''' This section is optional and not required for completing the quest, but it is required for future quests and it is convenient to do it now to save a future trip through the tunnels.

Each of these requires one talisman, for a total of four talismans plus their respective monkey bones if making all talismans in one go. You will save yourself several trips if you obtain all of these materials before going to [[Zooknock]] in the next section. You must kill one of each of the following:

==== Making the greegrees ====
Once you have all of the required bones (or monkey corpse) and talismans, you must run through the tunnels again, bringing your items to Zooknock. Travel through the tunnel for a second time, and when you reach the end, '''use''' the [[monkey talisman]] and all monkey bones (or corpses) on [[Zooknock]].

After a brief delay and conversation, you will get a greegree corresponding to the bones you used on him. To make another greegree, you have to first talk to him again and ask him if he can make another. '''If you cancel the conversation accidentally, ask how to make the monkey talisman and it will resume.''' If for some reason this doesn't work, try the [[drop trick]] with your previous greegrees, and go through the dialogue again. After all desired greegrees are made, bank or stock up as needed, and return to [[Ape Atoll]].

===Chapter 3===
'''"In which our hero finds themself contending with life as a monkey."'''

{{Needed|[[Karamjan monkey greegree]], [[m'speak amulet]], 1 free inventory space, and a method of reaching [[Ardougne]]}}
[[File:Awowogei chathead.png|left|frameless]]
In this chapter, you will be required to speak with [[Awowogei|King Awowogei]] and retrieve a monkey from the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. If you need to bank or in order to be more efficient, '''you can skip to retrieving the monkey in Ardougne''' (section "Monkey See, Monkey Zoo" below), and then speak with Awowogei when you return to Ape Atoll (steps 1-3).

1- Wield the [[monkey greegree]] to become a monkey. In this form, you will not be approached or attacked by any of the monkeys or wildlife on the island, and you cannot engage in combat. As a Karamjan monkey, return to [[Garkor]] and speak with him. If you are transformed into a different kind of monkey, he'll tell you to change and come back. After you finish talking, with the m'speak amulet equipped, talk to the [[Elder Guard]] near Garkor. The guard will tell you to speak with [[Kruk]].

2- From the guard, run west until you pass the main gate into [[Marim]] and have reached the Western shore of Ape Atoll (do not exit the gate). Head slightly south and follow the ground path up the western hill, then climb up the bamboo ladder at the top and cross the bamboo bridge. Climb down the ladder on the east side and speak to Kruk. After the conversation ends, he will conveniently take you back to [[King Awowogei]].

3- Speak to Awowogei and offer an alliance, and he will ask you to rescue a monkey from the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. Teleport out and make your way to Ardougne.[[File:Monkey Madness I - G.L.O. and Awowogei.png|thumb|300x300px|Caranock, Waydar and King Awowogei plotting.]]

====Monkey See, Monkey Zoo====
Once in [[Ardougne]], ensure you have an empty inventory space and then head to the south-west corner and enter the zoo. Wield the [[greegree]] inside the zoo area to become a monkey, and then speak to the [[Monkey minder]], who will place you in the cage. Speak with a [[Monkey (Monkey Madness I)|monkey]] (the only one with a "Talk" option), and it'll hop into your inventory; then, unequip the greegree and speak to the Monkey minder again. He will be confused and let you out.

You will now need to travel '''by foot''' to the [[Gnome Stronghold]]. You cannot use any form of teleportation (including [[random events]], spirit trees and fairy rings), as doing so will remove the monkey from your inventory, requiring you to re-obtain it from the zoo. The [[canoe system]] will work, however.

Once in the [[Gnome Stronghold]], talk to [[Daero]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} to travel back to Ape Atoll as usual.

:''Extra: Your new monkey friend will supply you with some humorous dialogue, and examining him will get you poked. If you have any [[bananas]] in your inventory, he will most likely eat them. There is also a 1/256 chance that he will give you a [[clue scroll (medium)]] if you use bananas on him directly. These can be obtained conveniently from the trees in the [[Monkey Child]]'s garden or [[Solihib's Food Stall]]. Note that you must go through the entire dialogue. Only one clue may be obtained per player{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/707250010379952128|date=9 March 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101498|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=1/256, and it's once only per player.}}.''

Once on Ape Atoll, equip your greegree and amulet to speak with Awowogei again. ''(If you have spoken before, simply speak to the Elder Guard to be let in; if not, refer to the section above).'' The monkey will automatically leave your backpack after speaking to Awowogei, and the king will consider an alliance.

Speak with Garkor to begin Chapter 4.

===Chapter 4, "The Final Battle"===
{{Needed|[[Greegree]], food, an antipoison, and [[combat equipment]] to defeat a level 195 [[Jungle Demon]]}}
[[File:Garkor chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Speak with Garkor one more time (as a human or monkey) to receive a [[10th squad sigil]]. '''''Do not equip it until you are ready for the final battle'''''. Make sure to hold onto the sigil, as if you lose it, Garkor will send you to [[Waymottin]] at the end of [[Zooknock]]'s tunnel to reclaim it.[[File:Monkey Madness I - Jungle Demon fight.png|thumb|350px|The 10th squad and the player fight the demon.]]

Bank in preparation for the [[Jungle Demon]] fight, and ensure you have full [[prayer points]] and health. When you are ready to fight, wear the sigil, and you will be promptly teleported to the Jungle Demon's arena.

'''note:'''
* You can wear the sigil, to start the fight, from anywhere in RuneScape; no need to return to Ape Atoll.
* Although you "wear" the sigil, it stays in your inventory and doesn't unequip your neck-slot equipment.
* Activate Protect from Magic '''''before''''' teleporting, and drink any necessary [[potions]].
* Switch to your weapon/unequip your greegree before teleporting. '''You will lose your greegree''' if you have it equipped and your inventory is full when you teleport.

Upon landing in the arena, you'll be confronted by a level 195 Jungle Demon which can hit up to 32 with both magic and melee. Protection prayers reduce all damage to zero; as such, if the player stands out of melee range, the fight can be completed by simply leaving on Protect from Magic and attacking the demon with Magic or Ranged. Note that the demon's melee attack can hit you even if you're two squares away, similar to a halberd; ensure you're three or more squares away to avoid it. Additionally, '''standing still''' once you are teleported to the arena will keep a distance between you and the Demon, who will not move until you do, although it will still attack you with Magic.

The 10th Squad gnomes will be nearby to assist with the fight, but '''you must deal the final blow to the demon yourself.''' If the gnomes deal the final strike, he will heal around 20 percent of his health (anywhere from 12%-25%); when the demon reaches 1 hitpoint, there will be a period where the gnomes stop attacking, so use this window to deal the final blow yourself.

The demon is weakest to Ranged, although Magic is fairly effective. Players should focus on their combat style with the highest damage. Note that the [[dwarf multicannon]] is effective against the demon, allowing [[pure]] accounts to kill him without gaining any [[Hitpoints]] experience; additionally, despite being from the jungle, he is not immune to poison. Melee is not recommended, but players looking to use melee combat will benefit from using rings of recoil, as the demon's melee attacks hit very accurately.
There is a [[safespot]] in the arena, across a bridge on the outside edge. When you run to the safespot, he will make his way to the bridge, but won't be able to fit over it. You may run further down the outside edge to stop him from attacking at all, allowing you to wait for the 10th Squad to weaken him, then returning to the bridge to deal the final blow.

If you die during the fight, the sigil can be reclaimed from Death's Office. No need to run through the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

==Finishing up==
{{Listen
|title = [[Mission Over (Monkey Madness)|Mission Over]]
|align = right
|filename = Mission Over (Monkey Madness).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon defeating the jungle demon.}}
[[File:Diamond detail.png|left|frameless|width=57x57]]
Once the Jungle Demon is slain, speak to Garkor, who is indicated by an arrow. He will tell you to speak to Zooknock; speak to Zooknock nearby to get the option to be teleported back to Ape Atoll. If players decline the offer and stay, they are free to explore the [[Banana plantation (Ape Atoll)|banana plantation]], but Zooknock will leave, requiring players to speak to [[Bonzara]] instead if they want to be teleported. He can be found in the crack at the base of the statue.
*'''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' The gnomes will teleport you into the jungle on Ape Atoll. It is advised to simply teleport off of the island as quickly as possible; players wishing to stay on the island should immediately equip their greegree after being teleported by the gnomes.
Escape the island however you like, either through the main gates as a monkey, with any form of teleport, or by jumping off the bridge in the south-east part of the city, and go back to the [[Gnome Stronghold]].

Speak with [[King Narnode]] in the [[Grand Tree]] to finish the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete! '''

==Trivia==
*[[Lumo]], [[Bunkdo]], and [[Carado]] will make a random comment each time the player is captured and thrown back into jail, with special dialogue upon being caught 10, 15, 20, 50, and 100 times. Additionally, the player will receive a [[stuffed monkey]] as a reward when being caught for the 100th time.
*If you talk to [[Zeke]], the scimitar seller of [[Al Kharid]], and ask him for a [[Dragon scimitar]], he will respond by saying, "The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never sell any to me. Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you hold a Dragon Scimitar," referencing when you pretend to be a monkey's uncle to obtain the [[monkey talisman]].
*If you have started [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]], completing this quest and receiving Daero's training unlocks a new [[fairy ring]] location in the [[Ape Atoll Agility Course|Ape Atoll agility course]]. This small area has two exits, one requires a [[ninja greegree]], as well as 48 [[Agility]] to continue through the remainder of the agility course. The other is a much slower route and crosses the nearby gorge by climbing the tower and crossing the rope bridge.
*If you wear a [[M'speak amulet]] and listen to the [[enchanted bar]], it says "I'm stuck in this horrible gold bar!"
*The chapter cards and cutscenes in this quest are references to the adventure game series ''{{Wp|Monkey Island}}''.
*Upon first talking to [[Awowogei]], [[Uwogo]] says to "never trust a northern monkey". This is about the friendly rivalry between the north and the south within the UK (Northern Monkeys, Southern Fairies).
*You can pick up the Karamjan monkey King Awowogei requests after bringing him to the island. If a player picks up the monkey delivered to King Awowogei after bringing him to the king, travels to Karamja by foot, and drops the monkey, the player will receive their level in Thieving experience multiplied by two.
*[[Karam]] seems to be a reference to Kalam Mekhar (a character from Steven Erikson's {{Wp|Malazan Book of the Fallen}}) and the 10th squad in general could be a reference to the Bridgeburners 9th squad from the same series.
*This entire quest was created by one intern at Jagex during a summer internship.
*If you give a monkey talisman back to the monkey child, he will be grateful and hug you.

==Walkthrough==
'''''Players are advised to read through each section before starting,''' as there are many different teleportation options that will vary by player and will determine items required before banking again. Players are also encouraged to complete as many stages of this quest as possible without any combat gear equipped, in order to preserve energy for running (as there is a lot of ground to cover). The walkthrough will alert you if there are any impending encounters where any combat items may be necessary. Each section will list the items required, you should only withdraw the necessary items to reduce weight until the next bank stop.''

===Karamja===

Travel to [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] and talk to [[Yanni Salika]] in the antiques shop north of the river. [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|CKR}} brings you close to the wall of [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]]. He will ask for a small favour: he wants you to bring him some [[red mahogany log]]s from a [[Jungle forester|forester]] south of the village.

:'''Tip:''' If you still need the gems required for later in the quest, you may choose to mine for them now while in Shilo Village (two of each of the following: jade, opal, sapphire, and red topaz). Use a [[chisel]] to cut the gems as you mine since there is a high chance to crush the gems.

Leave the village through both south-eastern gates, climbing over the broken cart. Talk to a forester just south-west of the entrance, who will ask the player to take a [[blunt axe]] to [[Captain Shanks]] for sharpening. [[Captain Shanks]] would refer you to [[Port Sarim]], so you may choose to skip talking to him.

===Asgarnia and Misthalin===
'''The first convenient bank visit to withdraw all these items is Draynor village.'''{{Needed|[[Blunt axe]] given by the Jungle Forester, 3 [[steel bar]]s, 1 [[harralander]], 2 [[guam]]s, 1 [[marrentill]], a [[bowl of hot water]], an [[empty cup]] (you may take a [[cup of tea]] during this part and drink it to get an empty cup)|recommended=Teleportation to [[Draynor]] ([[amulet of glory]]), [[Varrock teleport|Varrock]], [[Barbarian Village]] ([[skull sceptre]]), [[Dwarven Mine]] ([[skills necklace]] or [[Falador teleport]]), [[Taverley teleport|Taverley]], and [[Camelot teleport|Camelot]]. A [[lockpick]] is recommended for those with a low [[Thieving]] level.|skills={{SCP|Herblore|18}} {{Boostable|yes}} to make a guthix rest}}

Speak to [[Brian (axes)|Brian]] in the [[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar|axe shop]] in [[Port Sarim]], who will ask you to speak to Aggie the witch, so she can act as a character witness in the trial of his friend. '''Agree to see Aggie''' and ensure he has taken the axe before continuing.

'''BANK VISIT 1, withdraw the needed items above.'''

[[Aggie]] is found in [[Draynor Village]] (teleport using [[Amulet of glory]]). Talk to her about becoming a witness: she will agree to help, but she wants you to first investigate the [[H.A.M. Hideout]] for any sign of her missing apprentice, [[Jimmy the Chisel]].

The [[H.A.M. Hideout]] is found to the east of Draynor Village. Pick the lock on the trapdoor to enter, then speak to [[Johanhus Ulsbrecht]] in the south-eastern corner about Jimmy, who is being held hostage. Johanhus will agree to release him if the player agrees to supply a month's supply of chickens to their organisation, suggesting they talk to [[Fred the Farmer]].

Fred can be found in his house to the north-east of the H.A.M Headquarters, indicated with a [[dairy churn]] icon. After speaking to him, he will suggest you talk to [[Seth Groats]] instead as he does not have enough chickens.

Talk to Seth on the eastern side of the river by the chicken coop, who will agree to help. He needs some [[chicken cage|cages]] to transport the chickens for the player, and suggests you visit [[Horvik]] in [[Varrock]] for help. He also wants you to deliver to Horvik three [[steel bar]]s as another favour.

With the steel bars in your inventory, speak with Horvik in the [[Horvik's Armour Shop|armour shop]] north-east of [[Varrock Square]], to discover he is feeling ill. He wants some medicine and [[pigeon cage]]s to modify into chicken cages. You can bring him the medicine now and wait until later to retrieve the pigeon cages, as you will not yet need them.

Speak to the [[Apothecary]] in south-west Varrock about Horvik's illness and he will give you a [[herbal tincture]] while accidentally dropping the [[breathing salts]]. He now needs a new [[airtight pot]] to store them in.

:'''Note:''' You may drop the herbal tincture, as you can recover it later in the quest.

:'''Note:''' If you don't have the ingredients for the [[Guthix rest]] yet, now is the time to obtain them. A [[cup of hot water]] may be obtained by taking the [[cup of tea]] spawn by the [[tea seller]] just south of the eastern entrance to Varrock and drinking it to obtain an [[empty cup]]. Fill the cup with water at the water source to the south, then heat it on the cooking range to the west. The harralander, 2 guam, and marrentil can be obtained from the [[Grand Exchange]] or by killing chaos druids in the Edgeville dungeon.

Go to the [[Barbarian Village]] (teleport using the [[Skull sceptre]]), and talk to [[Tassie Slipcast]] the potter. She is too worried to show you how to make an airtight pot because she is being pressured by a dwarf called [[Hammerspike Stoutbeard]] in the [[Dwarven Mines]].

[[File:Dwarven Mine map.png|thumb|220px|Hammerspike and company is located on the far west end of [[Dwarven Mine]].]]

Go to the Dwarven Mines (teleport using the [[Skills necklace]] to Mining Guild, or take a [[Keldagrim_minecart_system|minecart from Keldagrim]]). Head north-west to the westernmost cave past the anvils until you see Hammerspike Stoutbeard surrounded by [[dwarf gang member]]s. Ask him, "Have you always been a gangster?", and he will tell you that he always wanted to be a druid. He wants you to convince the druid leader to let him join in return for leaving Tassie alone.

Go to [[Taverley]], and talk with [[Sanfew]], who is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the central house with the herb icon. Ask him if he's taking any new initiates and accepts dwarves, and tell him that a dwarf you know wants to become one. He will allow Hammerspike to become a druid apprentice, but he wants you to give a [[Guthix rest|Guthix rest tea]] to [[Captain Bleemadge]] on top of [[White Wolf Mountain]] and organise a trip for Sanfew down to the [[Feldip Hills]]. Use the [[harralander]] on the [[cup of hot water]] with two [[guam leaves]] and a [[marrentill]] in your inventory to create the guthix rest ({{SCP|Herblore|18}}).

Once you have the tea, travel to the top of White Wolf Mountain (gnome glider is one way). Speak to [[Captain Bleemadge]], and give him the [[Guthix rest|tea]]. He will want some T.R.A.S.H. (Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawsers) for the trip down to the Feldip Hills.
:'''Note:'''  If you have not completed [[The Grand Tree]], you must right-click and select the "Talk to" option for Bleemadge. Otherwise, he will not discuss the quest or accept the Guthix Rest.
:'''Note:''' Low levels should be aware of [[White wolf|white wolves]] while travelling on the mountain. An aggressive level 73 [[Big Wolf]] spawns near Captain Bleemadge which may attack you, preventing you from finishing the dialogue. Position Captain Bleemadge between yourself and the wolf to carry out the dialogue.

===Kandarin===
'''BANK VISIT 2, at catherby bank.'''{{Needed|A [[chisel]] (or 10 coins to buy one), spare cut [[jade]]s, [[opal]]s, and [[red topaz]]es (or about 2,000 coins to buy any spares needed).|recommended=Transportation to Ardougne, Port Khazard, and the Feldip hills.}}

Travel to the [[general store]] south of [[Catherby]] bank, and speak to [[Arhein]], who will ask for a [[weather report]]. Look on your map and go to the house with the water source north of the church in [[Seers' Village]] (teleport to Camelot and walk west). Speak with [[Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight]], located in the building with the water symbol, who is looking for a missing person and cannot do the weather forecast until she is found.

[[File:Goblin Cave Map.png|thumb|220px|[[Petra]] is located in the same room where [[Bouncer (ghost)|Bouncer]] and [[Slagilith]] are found.]]

Enter the [[Goblin Cave|cave]] east of the [[Fishing Guild]] entrance (teleport using a [[Skills necklace]]). Head north along the east wall until you come to a cave where [[Petra]] is trapped in a rock. Right-click and search the sculpture to find a message saying to speak to [[Wizard Cromperty]]. After finding the message, go to the north-east corner of [[Ardougne]] marketplace, find the house with the blue checkerboard floor, and speak to Wizard Cromperty about a girl stuck in some rock. He needs some [[iron oxide]] from a man in [[Port Khazard]]. If you don't have a [[hammer]] or [[chisel]] yet, you may acquire them in this building.

:'''Note:''' If you have yet to get the five [[pigeon cage]]s, go to the house directly south of the northern bank in East Ardougne. The cages are located outside the house along the east wall.

Go to Port Khazard ([[Ardougne cloak 1]] or [[Fishing Trawler]] [[Minigame Teleport]]) and speak to [[Tindel Marchant]], who will want his [[stodgy mattress]] stuffed with prime chompy bird feathers in return for the iron oxide.

:'''Note''': Lower level players should be aware of the level 53-63 ogres in the following area.

With your gems in your inventory, head to the [[Feldip Hills]] ([[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|aks}}, [[Feldip hills teleport]], or charter ship to [[Corsair Cove]] for 600 coins) and talk to [[Rantz]], who is located at the quest icon in eastern Feldip Hills. He is unable to give the player feathers as a "small man" is disturbing the chompy birds. Tell him that you'll see what you can do.

[[File:One Small Favour Landing strip repaired.png|thumb|220px|The landing strip, fully repaired.]]

Go west until you see a landing strip and [[Gnome glider]] with a gnome named [[Gnormadium Avlafrim]]. Talk to him, and he will tell you he needs to repair the landing strip. Search each of the eight landing lights for a [[gem]], cut it, and put it back in the landing lights. If you need a chisel, the gnome can sell you it. If you crush a gem, the gnome may also provide up to 2 spare gems of each type for {{NoCoins|500|c}} each, provided that you keep the crushed gems in your inventory.

:'''Tip:''' Due to the high cost of [[red topaz]] ({{NoCoins|{{GEP|Red topaz}}|c}}), if you crush one you may wish to utilise the [[drop trick]] with the replacement to buy an additional topaz at a discount.

===Completing the favours===
'''BANK VISIT 3, at seer's village bank, mainly to deposit all unused gems and withdraw the bronze, iron, steel bars.'''{{Needed|A [[stodgy mattress]], [[iron oxide]], an [[animate rock scroll]], the [[weather report]], an [[airtight pot]], [[breathing salts]], the [[herbal tincture]], [[chicken cage]]s, a [[sharpened axe]] and [[red mahogany log]]s, a good [[pickaxe]]/[[Weapons|weapon]], [[armour]] and some [[food]], a [[hammer]], a [[bronze bar]], an [[iron bar]], a [[steel bar]], 5 [[pigeon cage]]s|recommended=Runes for teleports to Ardougne, Camelot, and Lumbridge, transportation to Taverley, [[skills necklace]], [[skull sceptre]], and [[coins]] for transportation or some means of teleportation to get back to [[Shilo Village#Beginning the quest|Shilo Village]]. (Bring an extra piece of soft clay if you want to save some time during [[Swan Song]] later)}}

Talk with [[Gnormadium Avlafrim|Gnormadium]] to tell him the runway lights are fixed, then go back to [[Rantz]] to get the [[comfy mattress]]. Give the comfy mattress to [[Tindel]] in [[Port Khazard]] to get the [[iron oxide]]. Take the iron oxide to [[Wizard Cromperty]] in [[Ardougne]], and he will give you an [[animate rock scroll]].

====Goblin Cave & Slagilith====
[[File:One Small Favour misfire.png|thumb|220px|The player misfires the spell and animates Slagilith.]]
[[File:Slagilith fight.png|thumb|220px|right|A possible safespot for fighting Slagilith.]]
Prepare to fight a level 92 [[Slagilith]] in the following section. The Slagilith attacks within melee range and can hit up to 13 damage, though inaccurately. [[Protect From Melee]] will nullify all damage, and it may also be [[safespotted]] or [[flinched]] using the two rock piles nearby.

When fighting Slagilith, your damage will be reduced by 67% if a [[pickaxe]] is not '''equipped'''. {{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1219652159148646401|date=21 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107496|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=[The Slagilith] just reduces the damage to 33% if the attacker isn't wielding a pickaxe.}}. [[Combat spells]] will deal full damage as to Slagilith as long as a pickaxe is equipped, and Slagilith additionally has lower Magic defence. If using a pickaxe as your method of damage, set it to [[crush]] as the Slagilith is resistant to the other melee combat styles. 

The Slagilith will disappear within 5 minutes after it is summoned.

Once prepared for the fight, return to the [[Goblin Cave]] near the [[Fishing Guild]], and hug the eastern wall until you come to the same room as before. Stand in front of the [[sculpture]] and read the [[animate rock scroll]] to summon it.

:'''Note:''' If you get a message saying, {{Mes|You don't feel that you should cast this with enemies around}}, you may need to first kill the [[bats]] around the entrance.

After defeating Slagilith, stand back in front of the sculpture and read the scroll once more to release [[Petra]], then talk to her to send her back to Seers' Village.

:'''Note''': You may now drop the animate rock scroll.

====Seers' Village====
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Agility|36}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb a ladder, {{SCP|Smithing|30}} {{Boostable|yes}} to repair a weathervane|Hammer, bronze bar, iron bar, steel bar}}
Talk to [[Phantuwti]] in [[Seers' Village]] with 3 empty inventory spaces. He is unable to give you a weather report because his weather vane is broken. You'll have to go through all the chat options, and then ask him, "Why can't you get a clear picture?", and then ask, "Which special Seers tools do you need?" and "What do you mean, 'special combination of items'?" Finally, he'll tell you about his weather vane. Climb the ladder, head east, and climb another ladder to the roof of his house ({{SCP|Agility|36}}). Search the weather vane, use a [[hammer]] with the weather vane, and search it again to get three [[broken vane parts]]. Go to an anvil (closest is across the street) with a [[bronze bar|bronze]], [[iron bar|iron]], and [[steel bar]], and use the parts of the weather vane with the anvil ({{SCP|Smithing|30}}). Go back to the roof of the house, and put the [[weathervane pillar]], the [[directionals]], and the [[ornament]] back on the [[Seers weathervane]]. Talk to Phantuwti again for a (comically useless) [[weather report]].

:'''Note:''' If you lose the broken vane parts, you can recover them from Phantuwti for {{NoCoins|1000|c}}.

Take the report to [[Arhein]] in [[Catherby]], who will send somebody to send T.R.A.S.H. to [[Captain Bleemadge]]. Talk to Captain Bleemadge on top of [[White Wolf Mountain]]. (low and mid-levels should beware of the level 73 [[Big Wolf]] near Captain Bleemadge)

:'''Tip:''' Fly the glider to [[Feldip Hills]] to complete a medium [[Western Province Diary]] task.

Talk to [[Sanfew]] in [[Taverley]], and he will agree to let the dwarf become an initiate.

====Dwarven Mine & Gang Fight====
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Crafting|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to make a pot lid}}
[[File:One Small Favour dwarf fight.png|thumb|220px|A tussle with Hammerspike's gang.]]
Talk to [[Hammerspike]] in the [[Dwarven Mine]]. Predictably, he has "changed his mind" about becoming a druid. Talk to him again and he'll have his gang members attack you; they must be fought to continue the quest. There are three gang members (levelled in the mid-to-high 40s) in the room who will attack you at once and altogether can deal a fair amount of damage if you have no armour equipped, so come prepared for this battle (bring a weapon to end the fight quickly). You can use Hammerspike as a safespot provided you have not walked through him. '''Once they're dealt with, speak to Hammerspike again''', who will agree to stop harassing [[Tassie]].

Go to [[Barbarian Village]] and talk to Tassie, who will give you some [[soft clay]] and teach you how to make [[pot lid]]s. Use the soft clay on the wheel to make an unfired pot lid ({{SCP|Crafting|25}}) and then use the [[unfired pot lid]] on the [[pottery oven]]. Pick up the [[pot]] in the Village [[helmet shop.|helmet shop]] if you don't yet have one.

:'''Tip:''' Another pot lid is required for [[Swan Song]], so you may consider making a second one.

Go to the [[Apothecary]] in [[Varrock]], and give him the pot and pot lid in return for the [[Breathing salts|salts]].

Go back to [[Horvik]] the Varrock blacksmith, and give him the breathing salts and [[herbal tincture]], then '''talk to him again''' to replace the [[pigeon cage]]s with [[chicken cage]]s.

Go back to [[Seth Groats]] (his farm is on the east side of the [[River Lum]]) and give him the '''chicken''' cages.

Go to the [[H.A.M. Hideout|H.A.M. headquarters]], and tell [[Johanhus]] in the south-eastern-most room that you've managed to swing that [[chicken]] deal; he will agree to release [[Jimmy the Chisel|Jimmy]].

Go to [[Draynor Village]], and talk with [[Aggie]] the witch, who will agree to help [[Brian]].

Go to [[Port Sarim]], and Brian will give you the [[sharpened axe]] (after pulling your leg a bit).

====Finally back on Karamja====
Talk to '''any''' [[Jungle Forester|forester]] just south of the entrance to [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] to receive some [[red mahogany logs]] in exchange for the sharpened axe.

Speak with [[Yanni]] in Shilo Village to complete the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Note:''' You must use both rewarded [[Antique_lamp_(One_Small_Favour)|lamps]] before the quest will be '''officially''' completed, allowing the player to start [[King's Ransom]] and [[Swan Song]], and marking the quest as green in the quests list. Dropping the lamps will require the player to recover them from [[Yanni]] and use them before the sequel quests can be started. Whether this is by design or a bug is unclear.

==Trivia==
*Hammerspike Stoutbeard's desire to be a druid may stem from Pikel Bouldershoulder, a dwarf druid from several of R.A. Salvatore's books.
*Wizard Cromperty comments on the frequency with which people teleport into rock walls, saying that it can happen with just the smallest miscalculation. This may be a reference to the classic RPG Wizardry, which featured a teleport spell that, if cast with the wrong coordinates, could teleport you into a rock instead of the dungeon. This "feature" was notorious amongst Wizardry players, as it immediately killed your entire party.
*Petra Fiyed is a wordplay on the word "petrified," appropriately meaning "turned to stone".

Make your way to the Mountain Camp east of [[Rellekka]] and north-east of the [[Golden Apple Tree]]. To get to that area, you can use the [[enchanted lyre]] and head east; walk north from [[Seers' Village]] or use the [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|ajr}} and then go north a bit; or if your house is in Rellekka, teleport to your [[Player-owned house|house]] and go east, or by using Fremennik sea boots head east.

[[File:Mountain Daughter - Entering the mountain camp.png|thumb|left|A player using a rope to climb down the cliffside.]]
Start up the path to the [[Mountain Camp]], then head north up the slope above the guard. Use your [[rope]] on the boulder that says "push boulder" and you will automatically climb down.

{{clear}}

===Hamal's daughter===
[[File:Hamal the Chieftain chathead.png|left]]
Follow the path into the village, enter the longhouse to the east, and speak to [[Hamal the Chieftain]] by asking, ''"Why is everyone so hostile?"'', to begin the quest. Speaking of his tribe, Hamal tells you that they are citizens of [[Rellekka]], although due to differences they have moved out to become closer to nature, disagreeing with the [[Fremennik]] tradition of choosing their tools over skill. The chieftain tells you about his missing daughter and after much arguing against "employing" an outerlander, he eventually allows you to search for her. From this point on, you can enter the camp by climbing over the rockslide.

Head south of Hamal's house, and take some [[mud]] from the roots along the edge of the bubbling mud pond ([[swamp paste]] also works, but the mud can be obtained during the quest). 

If you did not bring a staff, go north of Hamal's house to [[Jokul]]'s place and pick up the [[pole]].

===Crisis ===
[[File:Mountain Daughter - Climbing the tree.png|thumb|Climbing the tall tree to gain access to the island.]]
Just north of Hamal's tent are [[mountain goat]]s. Follow the path leading west along the [[Shining pool]]. Follow it until you reach a tall tree by the geysers above the path you came up.

#Use the [[mud]] (or [[swamp paste]]) you gathered on the tall tree to prevent yourself from slipping.
# Climb the tall tree, crawl along its branch, and jump down to the little island.
#Use your [[pole]] or [[staff]] on the clump of rocks to pole-vault over them.
# Then use the [[plank]] to cross the flat stone.
#On one of the [[Shining pool (scenery)|bubbles]] rising from the pool, select "Listen-to Shining pool".

: '''Note:''' The [[Dramen staff]] can no longer be used as a pole vault as it was changed from a staff to a blunt weapon.<ref>Update: [[Update:QoL and Treasure Trails Feedback Changes|QoL and Treasure Trails Feedback Changes]] - April 18 2019</ref>

You hear the voice of the spirit of the chieftain's daughter [[Asleif Hamalsdotter]], who is dead. She asks you to make peace between her tribe and [[Rellekka]] and to also find a new food source for the camp. Agree to help her. To return to shore, use a plank on the flat stone. You can do her two tasks in either order.
:'''Note:''' Both tasks can be started at the same time. This reduces going back to the [[Mountain Camp]] multiple times. Plan it out accordingly.

===Making peace ===
{{Needed|A [[pickaxe]]}}

{{Map|name=Svidi|align=right|width=250|height=250|caption=Svidi's roaming area.|zoom=1|x=2724|y=3675|mtype=square|r=10}}
Return to the [[Mountain Camp]], and talk to [[Hamal the Chieftain]]. Ask about the people of [[Rellekka]], and he tells you that he sent a villager named [[Svidi]] to initiate a simple trade route, but he hasn't yet returned. Head to the rockslide that first blocked your entrance to the Mountain Camp. Climb over it, and go into the forest north-west of the rockslide, outside the entrance to Keldagrim. Locate and speak with Svidi. To find Svidi, go to the black unicorns and look for a fast moving yellow dot on your mini map between the fence shortcut and the south fence turn. you must run to catch him once spotted.
:'''Note:''' Make sure to choose the option "Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?", as the other option will cause him to walk off and you will have to find him again.

He will tell you he's afraid of the [[Fremennik]] in Rellekka and thinks that they might kill him. Offer to help him enter Rellekka and he agrees if you can secure a promise from the chieftain that he will be safe.

Head to Rellekka, and talk to [[Brundt the Chieftain]] in the longhall. He will promise not to hurt Svidi if you can retrieve a relic - an [[Ancient Rock|ancient rock]] - that the Mountain Camp tribe stole from Rellekka long ago.

[[File:Mountain Daughter - Mining the ancient rock.png|thumb|A player mining the Ancient Rock.]]
Return to the Mountain Camp, and enter the large tent south-west of Hamal the Chieftain. If you want, you can first talk to Hamal, but he refuses to let you have the rock. ''Right-click'' to use your [[pickaxe]] on the Ancient rock located in the southern tent to acquire [[half a rock]]. If you're wielding your [[pickaxe]], you will have to ''right-click on the'' ancient rock, as it cannot be mined using ''left-click''. Take this back to Rellekka, and talk to Brundt the Chieftain, who will agree to share the rock and give you a [[safety guarantee]] granting Svidi safe passage. Take the guarantee to Svidi to initiate peace talks between the two tribes.

'''Note:''' Once back in Rellekka with your pickaxe, now may be a good time to run north to the mine and gather some coal for the [[Fremennik Diary]] task.  Players will need to have completed [[The Fremennik Trials]] to enter the mine.

===Finding food===
{{Needed|A pair of [[gloves]]|recommended=A [[ring of dueling]] or [[Royal seed pod]] for [[Gnome glider]], or a [[Camelot Teleport]]}}

Return again to the [[Mountain Camp]] and speak with [[Hamal the Chieftain|Hamal]], and then talk to [[Jokul]], who is in the tent north of Hamal, looking after his [[mountain goat]]s. He will tell you that he thinks the members of the Mountain Camp could survive if the seed of a [[White pearl]] fruit, a hardy plant which can grow anywhere, were planted in the area.

:'''''Note:''' You must have talked to Jokul before being able to pick the fruit.''

[[File:Mountain Daughter - The thornbush.png|thumb|left|A thorny bush, just south of the [[gnome glider]] on the peak of [[White Wolf Mountain]].]]
Travel to the peak of [[White Wolf Mountain]] and look for [[thorny bushes]] near the [[gnome glider]]. If you have completed [[The Grand Tree]] [[quest]], you may use a [[ring of dueling]] to teleport to the [[Emir's Arena]] which is near a gnome glider. Head west from the Emir's Arena to the glider, then fly to the mountains. Alternatively, you may use a Camelot Teleport and walk up the mountain. Put on your [[gloves]] (4 damage will be inflicted if not wearing any, and you won't get the fruit seed), pick a [[White pearl]] fruit off the thorny bushes and eat it. You will automatically spit out the [[White pearl seed]].

Go back to the Mountain Camp and give the White pearl seed to Hamal the Chieftain, who accepts your solution for feeding the tribe.

===The Kendal===
{{Needed|An axe, combat equipment, a staff (or pole found near Jokul), and a plank}}

After you've completed both tasks, go back to the shining pool and speak to [[Asleif Hamalsdotter|Asleif]] again (make sure to pole vault, and use your [[plank]] on the flat stone). She asks you to convince her father that she is really dead. She was attacked by a creature ([[the Kendal]]) and dragged off nearby to the north where she was killed. Leave the island and head to the north side of the pool (alternatively, cross the gap without using the plank; you'll end up on the north side). Follow the path east to a [[Kendal's Lair|cave]] blocked by [[Dead tree (Mountain Daughter)|dead trees]]. Chop down the ones that block your path with an [[axe]] until you reach a [[Cave entrance (Kendal's Lair)|cave entrance]] (if you face problems chopping down the trees, stand to the west side of the first tree when chopping it down to walk over the stump).

Enter the cave and make your way to the large cavern. You find the Kendal as well as numerous corpses near a central pillar. Talk to the Kendal, and when it asks who you are, say, "It's just me, no one special", and then "You mean a sacrifice?". The Kendal tells you that it is the god of the northern lands.

Say that he actually looks like a man in a bearsuit, to which he finally admits. After you blow his cover, he also confesses to killing Asleif more than ten years ago. Humbly request her remains, to which he refuses as he cannot let anyone know his true identity. Threaten to kill him, and he'll attack you. He has 50 [[hitpoints]] and a [[combat level]] of 70, and all damage can be blocked if you use the [[Protect from Melee]] [[Prayer]]. If you are using [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], you can find a [[safespot]] around the skeletons to attack him.

: '''Note:''' It is possible to defeat the Kendal with a Dwarf Multicannon. If safespotting, be careful though: after attacking the boss, another one will spawn. The cannon will hit him too, making him aggressive, and repeating the process multiple times.

Once he dies, a [[Bearhead]] mask will appear in your [[inventory]]. Take Asleif's corpse, which lies in the south-eastern corner of the pillars ([[corpse of woman]]), and exit the cave. Cut your way back out of the dead trees and head back to [[Hamal the Chieftain]]. Tell him what you learned and show him his daughter's corpse.

<gallery widths="200">
File:Mountain Daughter - Entering the Kendal's cave.png|The Kendal's Lair.
File:Kendal safespot.png|The safespot for the Kendal.
</gallery>

===Finishing up===
[[File:Mountain Daughter - Creating the burial.png|thumb|A player creating the burial cairn for Asleif.]]
{{Needed|5 muddy rocks, a staff (or pole found by Jokul), and a plank}}

Hamal asks you to give her a proper burial by building a grave on the island at the centre of the pool topped with a cairn, symbolising the longboats used to cross the seas, and some of her possessions. He tells you perhaps [[Ragnar]] has one of her possessions for you to use. On your way up, gather five [[muddy rock]]s from the mountain goat pen. The rocks [[Spawning|respawn]] quickly, so it's possible just to pick up the same rock multiple times. 

Follow the path up to Ragnar (he is just past the tall tree), and speak with him. He gives you [[Asleif's necklace]], which he had intended to give her as a gift. Climb up the tall tree, pole-vault the clump of rocks, and use the plank on the flat stones to make your way back to the small island. Bury the corpse there; you will  go to the designated burial location. Use the muddy rocks on the burial mound to create Asleif's [[burial cairn]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Trivia==

*When you complete the quest, instead of hearing the normal quest complete music, the game plays Asleif's singing and you receive a message saying "You think you can hear a soft 'thank you' as the singing quietens down."
** Additionally, when Asleif asks you to make peace between her tribe and Rellekka, you can ask if this involves [[Good anthem|an anthem]]. This reference is available before beginning [[Throne of Miscellania]], however.
*[[The Kendal]] resembles, in both name and appearance, the monster {{Wp|Grendel}} from the famous old English poem ''{{Wp|Beowulf}}''.
*When you first talk to The Kendal, he quotes the Cave of Wonders guardian from ''{{Wp|Aladdin (1992 Disney film)|Aladdin}}'', "Who dares disturb my slumber?"
*When talking to The Kendal, you can ask him what he is doing in "that stupid bear suit", to which he will respond with the question "What are you doing in that stupid set of armour?" This is a reference to the movie ''{{Wp|Donnie Darko}}'' where Donnie asks the main antagonist, "Why are you wearing that stupid bunny suit?" To which he responds, "Why are you wearing that stupid man suit?"
*The ancient rock story-line appears to be a telling of the story of the Stone of Scone, which was stolen by the English in 1296 and then split in-two when an attempt was made to return the stone to Scotland in 1950.

{{External|rs}}{{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Recruitment Drive |number = 83 |image = [[File:Recruitment Drive.png|300px]] |release = [[27 June]] [[2005]] |update = Recruitment Drive |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Temple Knight|Temple Knight]], #1 |developer = {{RSL|Mod James|James B}} }} '''Recruitment Drive''' is the first quest in the [[List of quest series#Temple Knight series|Temple Knight series]]. It marks the first appearance of [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]], who recruits you for the [[Temple Knights]]. However, the recruitment process involves several puzzles to test your wits. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Sir Amik Varze]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[White Knights' Castle]]'s western tower in [[Falador]]. |startmap = 2959,3336,plane:2 |difficulty = Novice |description = The Temple Knights of Saradomin, a secret organisation founded many centuries ago by Saradomin himself, are currently looking to expand their ranks with some new blood. After the successful thwarting of the Black Knights' plans to take over Asgarnia, and with the personal recommendation of Sir Amik, you have now been offered the chance to apply for membership in this organisation... but are you up to the challenge? |length = Short |requirements = *Completion of the following quests: **[[Black Knights' Fortress]] **[[Druidic Ritual]] |items = |recommended = *{{SCP|Combat|10|link=yes}} *{{SCP|Strength|5|link=yes}} |kills = [[Sir Leye]] (level 20) |ironman = [[File:Hardcore ironman chat badge.png]] You will lose your Hardcore ironman status if you die to Sir Leye.
[[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] This quest requires an empty inventory and no items worn. |leagueRegion = {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===Starting out=== {{Map|name=Sir Amik Varze|x=2960|y=3337|r=3|plane=2|mtype=square|align=left|width=200|height=200|caption=The start point of the quest.}} To start the quest, speak to [[Sir Amik Varze]] who is located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the western part of the [[White Knights' Castle]]. He will tell you to talk to [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]] in [[Falador Park]] to be tested. In order to be able to be tested, '''you need to have an empty inventory''' and no items equipped. Now, head to Falador Park, and talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien. He will tell you that you must go through a mental test. Sir Tiffy Cashien is sitting on a bench at the entrance for Falador Park. {{Clear|left}} ===Testing=== [[File:Sir Tiffy Cashien chathead.png|left]] [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]] will take you to the testing grounds. There are seven different testing rooms. In each room, there is a yellow portal at the beginning of the room (takes you back to [[Falador]]) and a yellow portal at the end of the room, which you may use to travel to the next room after you pass the test. You need to complete five in a row. Which five you'll get, as well as the order that they are in, is completely random. However, you will '''always''' be required to defeat [[Sir Leye]] in one of the five tests. If you fail a test, you have no choice but to return to Falador and start over. {{Clear|left}} ===Sir Kuam Ferentse=== [[Sir Kuam Ferentse|He]] tells the player that they must defeat [[Sir Leye]], who is level 20. Sir Leye has been blessed by [[Saradomin]] so that no blade may harm him. There are four weapons nearby: a [[steel sword]], [[steel claws]], a [[steel battleaxe]], and a [[steel warhammer]]. Any of the weapons can be used to damage Sir Leye, but the player must choose the warhammer (as it is the only non-bladed weapon) or may opt to fight unarmed for the final blow to kill him. If the player is wielding a bladed weapon when he dies, they will fail the test. '''Note:''' [[Skiller]]s can trap Leye in the corners of the room and [[flinch]] him by waiting for his HP bar to go away and then hitting and running. Skillers may find this part impractical because Sir Leye is very difficult to get into the corner positions ''and'' he will take damage very slowly, to the point where he may heal faster than the damage being done. One of the corners where flinching is possible is on the south-west corner. Sir Leye should be on the south tile with the player on the west tile. Wait until his HP bar disappears, then attack and move back to the west tile. Setting this up is tricky and requires patience. {{Listen |title = [[Wisdom (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Wisdom (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Sir Kuam Ferentse's puzzle.}} {{clear}} ===Sir Spishyus=== Right next to [[Sir Spishyus|him]], you'll see a 5 kg chicken, a 5 kg bag of grain, and a 5 kg fox. You must get all three of them across a bridge that only supports five kilograms at a time. The tricky part is that if you leave the fox and chicken alone, the fox will eat the chicken. The chicken will also eat the bag of grain if the two of them are left alone. [[File:Recruitment Drive - Walking across the bridge.png|thumb|Crossing the bridge.]]'''Option 1''' {{Checklist|*Take the chicken to the other side, since the fox and grain are the only pair that actually get along. *Drop the chicken, then come back and grab the grain. *Take it to the other side then grab the chicken and drop the grain. Then take the chicken back to the start. *Grab the fox, drop the chicken, and take the fox across the bridge. *Drop the fox, then go back to the beginning for the chicken, take it across and drop the chicken.}} '''Option 2'''{{Checklist| *Take the chicken to the other side, since the fox and grain are the only pair that actually get along. *Drop the chicken, then come back and grab the fox. *Take it to the other side then grab the chicken and drop the fox. Then take the chicken back to the start. *Grab the grain, drop the chicken, and take the grain across the bridge. *Drop the grain, then go back to the beginning for the chicken and take it across. }} Once you complete the puzzle, the door now unlocks and you can proceed to the next puzzle via the portal. {{Listen |title = [[Order (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Order (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Sir Spishyus's puzzle.}} {{clear}} ===Lady Table=== [[File:Recruitment Drive - Statue Room.png|thumb|The bronze, silver, and gold statues used in the memory test.]] '''Important:''' Take a screenshot of the statues as you enter the room (or remember the statues if you have a good memory). You only have a few seconds after you enter the room! If you talk to Lady Table before the room changes, the room won't change until you exit the chat dialogue, so you can use this time to study the room layout. [[Lady Table]] will test your memory. She will have 11 statues of a knight in front of her. There are supposed to be 12, but one has been taken away. You will have a few seconds to look at the statues, then the missing one will be returned. You must then touch the one that was missing. The trick to passing this one is to analyse the types of statues. There should be four statues of each colour: bronze, silver, and gold. First, see which colour only has '''three statues'''. After you figure out the colour, figure out the weapon. There are four weapons: [[sword]], [[halberd]], greataxe, and [[mace]]. Figure out which weapon is missing. After you have figured it out, touch the statue. {{Listen |title = [[Logic (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Logic (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Ms. Hynn Terprett's puzzle.}} {{clear}} ===Miss Cheevers=== There are many bookcases and crates with items. Search everything (including the chest) and take everything. Some of the items you find are not needed for the solution, such as the [[alchemical notes]] that only contain hints. There are two doors that you must get through. The first door is missing a handle, while the second one is locked. =====For the first door===== [[File:Recruitment Drive - Pouring liquid on the handle.png|thumb|Using the [[vial of liquid]] on the new handle.]] {{Checklist| *Take the metal spade, and use it on the Bunsen burner to remove the wood. *Use the metal spade (without handle) on the stone door. *Use the [[cupric sulfate]] (not to be confused with the other orange cupric powder!) on the door with the metal spade in it *Use a vial of liquid on the door. *The metal spade will expand and be jammed in the hole, and you can now open the door. }} =====For the second door===== {{Checklist| *Use a [[vial of liquid]] on the tin (which looks like a [[cake tin]]); *Use [[gypsum]] on the tin. Do not use the liquids on each other. *Use the tin with the lumpy white liquid inside of it on the key (on the ground south of the portal you came from) to get an imprint of the ''key''. *Use [[tin ore powder]] on the tin. *Use [[cupric ore powder]] on the tin. *Use the tin on the Bunsen burner to make a duplicate [[Bronze key (Recruitment Drive)|bronze key]]. *Use a [[knife]], [[chisel]] ''or'' [[bronze wire]] on the tin to obtain the bronze key; you can now use the bronze key on the door to open it. }} {{Listen |title = [[Improvisation (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Improvisation (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Miss Cheevers' puzzle.}} {{clear}} ===Sir Ren Itchood=== When you talk to [[Sir Ren Itchood]], he will speak in riddles, the answer to which is a four letter word, made up of the first letter of each line of his riddle. Use the answer to unlock the combination lock on the next door. The possible solutions are: '''BITE''', '''FISH''', '''LAST''', '''MEAT''', '''RAIN''' or '''TIME'''. {{Listen |title = [[Observation (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Observation (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Sir Ren Itchood's puzzle.}} {{clear}} ===Ms. Hynn Terprett=== [[Ms. Hynn Terprett|She]] will give you a multiple choice riddle. There are many to choose from - they are as follows: *'''Riddle:''' ''Imagine that you have been captured by an enemy. You are to be killed, but in a moment of mercy, the enemy has allowed you to pick your own demise - being drowned in a lake of acid, burned on a fire, thrown to a pack of wolves that have not been fed in over a month or thrown from the walls of a castle, many hundreds of feet high.'' **'''Answer:''' Being fed to the wolves - wolves cannot survive for 30 days without food, thus they would all be dead. *'''Riddle:''' ''I have both a husband and daughter. My husband is four times older than my daughter. In twenty years time, he will be twice as old as my daughter. How old is my daughter now?'' **'''Answer:''' Her daughter is 10 years old. Writing out the given information in the form of the equation 4x+20=2(x+20), we can find easily the daughter's age 𝑥. Balancing the equation gives us \left ( \frac{4x+20=2(x+20)}{2} \right )=\bigl((2x+10)-10=(x+20)-10\bigr)=\bigl(2x=x+10\bigr), from which we can finally subtract an 𝑥 from each side to get x=10. *'''Riddle:''' ''I dropped four identical stones, into four identical buckets, each containing an identical amount of water. The first bucket was at 32 degrees Fahrenheit, the second was at 33 degrees, the third was at 34 and the fourth was at 35 degrees. Which bucket's stone dropped to the bottom of the bucket last?'' **'''Answer:''' The first bucket (Bucket A). At 32 degrees Fahrenheit (0 degrees Celcius) the bucket of water is frozen, so the stone never reaches the bottom. *'''Riddle:''' ''I estimate there to be 1 million inhabitants in the world of Gielinor, creatures and people both. What would be the number you would get if you multiply the number of fingers on everythings left hand, to the nearest million?'' **'''Answer:''' Zero. There are creatures with zero fingers anything multiplied by zero is zero. *'''Riddle:''' ''Which of the following is true? The number of false statements here is one. The number of false statements here is two. The number of false statements here is three. The number of false statements here is four. How many false statements are there?'' **'''Answer:''' Logic dictates that the number of false statements must be three. There are four possible answers, so for one of them to be true, all others must be false. {{Listen |title = [[Memory (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Memory (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Lady Table's puzzle.}} {{clear}} ===Sir Tinley=== Talk to [[Sir Tinley]], click on "continue". Stand still for eight seconds, do not click on '''anything''' after clicking continue, or the player will fail this task. {{Listen |title = [[Patience (Recruitment Drive)]] |align = left |filename = Patience (Recruitment Drive).ogg |desc = Plays upon completing Sir Tinley's puzzle.}} {{clear}} ====Finishing up==== After completing all five tests subsequently, you will automatically be teleported back into [[Falador Park]] where [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]] will congratulate you on a job well done. '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Recruitment Drive |image = [[File:Recruitment Drive reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 1 |rewards = * {{SCP|Prayer|1,000.5}} [[Prayer]] experience *{{SCP|Herblore|1,000.5}} [[Herblore]] experience *{{SCP|Agility|1,000.5}} [[Agility]] experience *3,000 [[coins]] *Access to [[initiate armour]]. You will be given a [[Initiate sallet|sallet]] for free, and you can buy subsequent sallets from Sir Tiffy Cashien for 6,000 [[coins]], the [[Initiate cuisse|cuisse]] for 8,000 coins, the [[Initiate hauberk|hauberk]] for 10,000 coins, or the full set for 20,000 coins. It is aesthetically similar to [[White equipment#Armour|white armour]], with a gold trim. *The Gaze of Saradomin - When you die, you will have the option of returning to [[Falador]] instead of [[Lumbridge]]. Talk to [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]] to change your spawn point at any time. * Appointment with the [[title|title of Initiate]] in the [[Temple Knights|Order of Temple Knights]].{{note|The validity of this title is disputed in the quest Wanted!}} }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Recruitment Drive is required for the following: *[[Wanted!]] *[[Medium Falador Diary]] ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|Quest}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 9 November 2022 |update = Diversity & Inclusion Changes and Quest Speedrunning Updates |change = Sir Leye must now be defeated by one of four weapons instead of only by female player characters. }} {{Subject changes |date = 11 October 2018 |update = Spellbook Rework, Wise Old Man and, Increased Zoom |change = A confusing phrase was reworded within the Recruitment Drive quest's dialogue. }} {{Subject changes |date = 26 July 2018 |update = Revenant Cave Rewards and Troll Quest Announcement |change = Fixed an issue during Recruitment Drive which prevented you from advancing after completing Sir Kuam Ferentse's task. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== * When asking [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]] about ''"Testing...?"'' near the beginning of the quest, the player mentions fetching common items and delivering them across the country, a reference to the quest [[One Small Favour]]. * Prior to [[Update:Diversity & Inclusion Changes and Quest Speedrunning Updates|an update]] on [[9 November]] [[2022]], [[Sir Leye]] could only be defeated by female characters, as it was said he had been blessed by [[Saradomin]] so that no "man" could defeat him. His former invincibility against any man may have been a reference to the prophecy of Glorfindel, featured in J. R. R. The prophecy was fulfilled as he is killed by Éowyn, shieldmaiden of Rohan, and the hobbit Merry. * All of the knights' names are puns: ** Sir Tiffy Cashien - Certification ** Sir Kuam Ferentse - Circumference ** Sir Leye - Surly ** Sir Spishyus - Suspicious ** Miss Hinn Terprett - Misinterpret ** Sir Tinley - Certainly ** Sir Ren Itchood - Serenitude ** Lady Table - Lay the Table ** Miss Cheevers - Mischievous ** Sir Vey Lance - Surveillance ** Sir Amik Varze - Ceramic Vase ** Sir Vyvin - Surviving ** Sir Renitee - Serenity ** Sir Rebral - Cerebral {{Recruitment Drive}}

}} ==Walkthrough== ===Starting the quest=== [[File:Eluned chathead.png|left]] Talk to [[Eluned]], who teleports between three different locations. Refer to the map on the [[Roving Elves]] quest page for these locations. You may travel to any of them and then switch worlds to find her. She will lead you to the rebel elven outpost [[Lletya]]. Talk to [[Arianwyn]], the leader of the elves in this outpost. He will reveal to you that the [[mourner]]s in [[West Ardougne]] are really [[Iorwerth]] elves from [[Prifddinas]], and that it is your job to uncover their evil plot. He will tell that these mourners frequently cross the overpass of [[Arandar]] between the elven capital and West Ardougne, allowing you to easily ambush one there. Arianwyn then gives you a [[teleport crystal]] that allows you to teleport back to Lletya. This crystal contains charges, with one being consumed per teleportation. It starts with four charges. If the crystal is used efficiently, this will be enough teleports for both this quest and [[Mourning's End Part II|Part II]]. [[Eluned]] is able to grant it three charges whenever it becomes uncharged, or five charges if the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]] is completed. She charges a maximum of 750 coins for this service, although you would have to find her again first. ===Obtaining mourner gear=== [[File:Arandar.png|thumb|right|The northern entrance to the [[Arandar]] pass.]] {{Needed|[[Bucket of water]], 2 [[silk]], [[bear fur]] and 7 empty inventory spaces.|recommended=[[Weapon]], [[food]] (if low combat stats), [[necklace of passage]], [[ring of dueling]], Fast travel to [[Taverley]] ([[House teleport]], [[Balloon network]], [[Falador teleport]]), and a [[teleport crystal]]}} Head towards the entrance of [[Arandar]]. The fastest way is by travelling with the [[necklace of passage]] to the [[Outpost]], then walking westwards. There, kill a level-11 [[mourner]] to obtain their outfit. Right before you land your first hit, they will always attempt to throw a potion that reduces your combat stats to 20, including your [[Hitpoints]]. Stats reduced this way cannot be instantly restored with a potion. However, they may be restored by entering the [[Nightmare Zone]], with the [[pool of refreshment]] in the [[Ferox Enclave]], or the [[Fancy rejuvenation pool|fancy]] or [[ornate rejuvenation pool]] in the [[player-owned house]]. It is possible to kill the mourner without having your stats reduced, if you initiate combat with a weapon that can either 1-hit kill it, or hits multiple times at once to add up enough damage to kill it. For example, a spec attack from a [[Magic shortbow]] is one possible method. You will need everything that the mourner drops, excluding their [[bones]] and the broken glass: *[[Gas mask]] *[[Bloody mourner top]] *[[Ripped mourner trousers]] *[[Mourner boots]] *[[Mourner gloves]] *[[Mourner cloak]] *[[Mourner letter]] Because the top is covered in blood, you will first have to clean it before it can be worn. Go to [[Taverley]] and talk with the druid [[Tegid]], who is doing his laundry by the lake. He will however refuse to lend you his [[Tegid's soap|soap]]. Therefore, you must steal it from his laundry basket (with level 50 [[Thieving]]). While holding a [[bucket of water]], use the soap on the bloody mourner top to [[mourner top|clean]] it. Tegid's soap is no longer required after this point, so you may drop it or deposit it in the bank as a souvenir to save an inventory spot. Travel to [[Lletya]], optimally with the [[teleport crystal]], to repair the pair of trousers. Talk to the elven seamstress [[Oronwen]], who will be able to repair the trousers if provided with a [[bear fur]] and two [[silk]]. You may also purchase the required [[dyes]] ([[red dye|red]], [[yellow dye|yellow]], [[green dye|green]], and [[blue dye|blue]]) from her if you haven't acquired them yet. ===Infiltrating the headquarters=== {{Needed|[[Mourner letter]], the full [[mourner gear]], [[feather]], [[magic logs]], [[leather]], [[toad crunchies]] or [[premade t'd crunch]], and 2 empty inventory spaces.}} Wearing the full [[mourner gear]], you may enter the [[Mourner Headquarters]] in [[West Ardougne]], located in the north-east corner of the city. Enter the basement via the [[trapdoor (Mourner Headquarters)|trapdoor]] in the north-western corner, where you will find level-108 [[mourner]]s and their commander, [[Essyllt]]. Speak with him to show him your letter, and he welcomes you aboard. Essyllt will explain to you that their job is to keep the people of Ardougne believing in the plague. One of their ways of doing it involved dyeing Farmer Brumty's sheep. However, their colour is starting to vanish and they will need to be redyed, a task he assigns you to do. Normally, they use a gnomic device to dye them unseen from a distance, however it has broken down and the [[Gnome (Mourner Headquarters)|gnome tinkerer]] refuses to tell the elves how to repair it. The elf allows you to interrogate the gnome and hands you the [[broken device]] and a [[tarnished key]] to the torture chamber. Speak with this gnome in the adjacent room to learn about the variety of torture methods the elves already tried on him. He will accidentally spill that he is vulnerable to having his feet tickled and that he craves for some [[toad crunchies]], and then realises his mistake. Repeat what he said back to him. {{Chat option|3 You talked about toad crunchies and being tickled}} Then ''use'' a [[feather]] on the gnome to tickle him while having the toad crunchies or a [[premade t'd crunch]] in your inventory. Make sure to '''not''' give him the toad crunchies before tickling him, or you will need new ones. The gnome will beg you to stop. Get him off the rack so he may fix the broken device, if you provide him with [[magic logs]] and [[leather]]. He will then hand you a [[fixed device]]. Talk with him again to ask him about the ammunition needed, which turns out to be dyed [[swamp toad]]s that gruesomely explode when launched from the device. ===Sheep=== [[File:Fixed device aim.png|thumb|200px|The aim and fire interface.]] {{Needed|[[Fixed device]], [[red dye]], [[blue dye]], [[yellow dye]], [[green dye]] and an [[ogre bellows]].}} {{Map|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=Location of the sheep. |2609,3389,title:Location of the yellow sheep,icon:yellowPin,desc: |2620,3368,title:Location of the green sheep,icon:greenPin,desc: |2608,3346,title:Location of the red sheep,icon:redPin,desc: |2569,3383,title:Location of the blue sheep,icon:bluePin,desc: }} These toads can be found in the [[Feldip hills]]. You may easily reach this location with a [[Feldip hills teleport]] or by travelling with [[fairy rings]] to {{Fairycode|AKS}}. Alternatively, they can be found south of Castle Wars, easily accessible with a [[ring of dueling]] or by travelling with [[fairy rings]] to {{Fairycode|BKP}}. Similar to how you have captured the toads during the [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] quest, you will require an [[ogre bellows]]. However, instead of filling it with swamp gas, you need to '''''use''''' dye on it. Using a dyed ogre bellows on a swamp toad results in an inflated toad of that colour. Inflate at least one toad in each of the four colours (for safety you can use extra dyes get multiple toads in each colour, as the toad will be used up if you miss during the next step), and then travel to the coloured sheep from the [[Sheep Herder]] [[quest]] north of [[Ardougne]]. Use one of the coloured toads on the [[fixed device]], and then wield the device. When near the flock of sheep in that colour, select ''Aim and Fire'' in [[Combat Options]], and aim the crosshair at any of the sheep in the flock. Shoot by pressing the red button in the centre of the crosshair. Successfully hitting one will coat the entire flock of sheep. Repeat the process for the other three colours. When finished, return to [[Essyllt]]. ===Another favour=== {{Needed|Full [[mourner gear]] and a [[barrel of naphtha]] (or at least 10 [[coal]] to make the barrel).}} Essyllt will tell you that someone has [[Biohazard#Infiltrating the Mourner HQ|poisoned their stew]] recently, causing them to get plague-like symptoms. He will want to apply these symptoms on some of the citizens to stimulate the rumour of the plague. You will need to reproduce the poison. Take a [[rotten apple]] north-west of the [[Mourner Headquarters]]. Rotten apples from elsewhere will not work. Go to [[Elena]], the scientist you rescued during [[Plague City]]. Her house is north-west in [[East Ardougne]]. Ask her for help, and she will reluctantly give in. Continue talking to her and hand her the apple, eventually she hands you a [[sieve]] that you will need later. [[File:Mashing apples.png|thumb|200px|Mashing the rotten apples.]] Travel to the [[apple orchard]], located directly west of the [[Combat Training Camp]], a short distance north-west from Elena's house. In the orchard, take a [[barrel]] and use it on a [[rotten apple pile]]. Then, use the barrel of [[rotten apples]] on the [[apple press]]. You will elegantly mash them up into an [[apple barrel]]. You will now require a [[barrel of naphtha]]. If you already have one, skip to the ''[[#Poisoning the Food|Poisoning the Food]]'' section. [[File:Regicide - Coal tar location.png|thumb|left|200px|The location to obtain the coal-tar.]] You now need to add a solvent to make the poison nonlethal and undetectable. Take another barrel from the apple orchard or [[Tyras Camp]], and use it on the [[Coal Tar|coal tar swamp]] south of [[Isafdar]] to get a [[barrel of coal tar]]. Then, gather at least 10 regular [[coal]] and go to the [[Chemist]]'s house in [[Rimmington]]. Follow these simple steps to obtain a barrel of naphtha: #Rotate the tar regulator clockwise twice to make the tar flow at its maximum. The 'pressure' indicator on the left should go up. #When the pressure enters the green region, rotate the pressure valve clockwise once to let out some pressure. This should stall the pressure indicator. #Start adding coal. This raises the 'heat' indicator on the right. If it is below the green region, add more coal. If it is above, do not add coal until it gets lower. #If the heat reading reaches the dark orange portion, you have spoiled your compound and must start again; although the coal is wasted, it can be redone with the same barrel of tar. #If you run out of coal, your progress will be saved. This means you do not have to re-set the pressure or re-add coal to it. When the green bar on the bottom is full, stop adding coal and close the window to replace your barrel of coal tar with a barrel of naphtha. ===Poisoning the food=== {{Needed|Full [[mourner gear]], [[barrel of naphtha]], [[apple barrel]] and the [[sieve]].|recommended=[[Teleport crystal]].}} Use the [[barrel of naphtha]] on the [[apple barrel]] to get a [[naphtha apple mix]]. Then, use your [[sieve]] on it to obtain a barrel of [[toxic naphtha]]. The sieve is no longer needed after this point. After first ensuring that you have two free inventory slots, cook this product on a [[range]] in order to turn it into two heaps of [[toxic powder]] (there is a range inside the [[Mourner Headquarters]]). It must be a range, '''do not''' use a fire! Once the toxic powder is made, you no longer need the empty barrels. Place the powder on any two of the three sack of grain locations in [[West Ardougne]]. These are found inside the [[Civic Office of West Ardougne|office]] north of the [[manhole (West Ardougne)|manhole]], just outside the [[West Ardougne General Store|general store]], and inside the church. Go back to Essyllt once more, who will now trust you enough to disclose secret information. Their plan is to delve into the mountains, with the help of enslaved citizens of West Ardougne, under the pretext they fell victim to the plague. They will make a tunnel towards the [[Temple of Light]], to make it easier to resurrect their "Dark Lord". After talking to [[Essyllt]], head back to [[Lletya]] ([[teleport crystal]]) and talk to [[Arianwyn]] to complete the quest.
