===Milk===
You will be asked a general question about ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. Answer three correctly to get it enchanted.

''Some'' of the questions:
*Combat level of Goblins near Lumbridge - 2
*What is the defence level requirement to wear a Mystic Hat? - 20
*Glass vial is to 33 as a glass orb is to - 46
*A gold ring is to 5 as a holy symbol is to - 16
*How much GP does it take to bribe a guard at the toll gate to Al Kharid prior to earning their trust? - 10
*I can hear howling in one direction and buzzing in the other—where am I? - Catherby
*If I'm going to need glass, first I will need - Sand, bucket, soda ash, glassblowing pipe
*I'm in a bar west of Pollnivneach. Where am I? - Bandit Camp
*Take the number of fire runes required to cast Fire Strike, and multiply by the number of air runes used to cast Wind Strike before adding the number of earth runes used to cast Earth Wave. What do you get? - 10
*The River Salve runs from - North to south
*What doesn't lie between Morytania and Asgarnia? - Keep Le Faye
*What Ingredients are used in a cake? - Flour, eggs, milk
*Which tower is closest to the Crafting Guild - Dark Wizards' Tower
*What is the nearest guild to the Fishing Platform (as the seagull flies)? - Legends'

===Flour===
You must pass a memory test. You will be shown 3 groups of ten items out of a total of 5 groups, then must answer a question about them. Answer three correctly to get [[enchanted flour]]. When answering the questions, don't use the ESC key to close the interface as it will reset that portion of the test.

''Some'' of the questions:

*Which item began with the letter 'm'? - [[Mind talisman|Mind Talisman]]
*Which of the following items were NOT shown to you? - [[Trout]]
*How many weapons were you shown? - Three ([[Maple longbow|Maple Longbow]], [[Magic shortbow|Magic Shortbow]] and [[Black longsword|Black Longsword]])
*How many types of rune were there? - Two ([[Fire rune|Fire Rune]] and [[Chaos rune|Chaos Rune]])
*Which items were amongst those you were shown? - [[Book of Balance]] (noted as Guthix Prayer Book,) [[Magic logs|Magic Logs]], [[Pike]]

==Walkthrough==
----
'''Inspect Awowogei in the Lumbridge Castle dining room to start the quest''', then travel to [[Ape Atoll]].

'''Recommended items''' throughout the stay at Ape Atoll: [[M'speak amulet]], [[Karamjan monkey greegree]] (or other greegrees), [[antipoison]] and [[food]].

The easiest way to get to Ape Atoll is to use fairy ring code {{Fairycode|clr}}, which leads to the middle of the [[Ape Atoll Agility Course|agility course]]. If you have a [[Ninja monkey greegree|ninja greegree]] (required later), equip it and complete the agility course. Otherwise, attempt the rope swing as a human. You will fall and be put in jail. Then you can equip a different greegree, pick the lock and leave.

You can also get to Ape Atoll by going to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Grand Tree]] and speaking to [[Daero]].

===Greegrees===
'''Note: if you already obtained the ninja, zombie and gorilla greegrees during [[Monkey Madness I]], you can skip this section.'''
{{Needed|3,000 [[coins]] or 3 [[monkey talisman]]s|recommended=Combat equipment to kill a [[ninja monkey]] and a [[zombie monkey]], Ranged or Magic equipment to kill a [[monkey guard]], prayer potions, stamina potions, and food for combat and running through Ape Atoll dungeon}}

In order to make the three required greegrees, you must bring a [[monkey talisman]] and the respective bones to [[Zooknock]], who is located at the end of the [[Ape Atoll Dungeon]]. Monkey talismans can be purchased from the rune salesman [[Tutab]] on Ape Atoll for 1,000 coins each, or obtained for free from the [[Monkey Child]].

Once you land on Ape Atoll, head north with a greegree equipped (use the [[Karamjan monkey greegree|karamjan greegree]] if you do not have the others) and pass through the gate. Purchase three monkey talismans from the rune salesman. Next, kill a [[Monkey Guard]] and take its bones. Monkey Guards are located near the prayer altar on Ape Atoll. Make sure to use Ranged or Magic and [[safespot]] them,  Melee can be used but Monkey Guards will heal themselves when they reach low health so high damage is needed to combat this. A safespot location is in the north-east corner of the building behind the fire, or to the south behind the ladder.

Next you will need to kill a [[Monkey Archer]]. North of the bank icon on the mini-map are two ninja monkeys (monkey archers); either protect from range or safespot (by standing in the tall grass) to kill one. Make sure to grab the bones.

[[Zombie monkey]]s can be found in the Ape Atoll dungeon (entrance located on the south side of the island). This is the same cave that [[Zooknock]] can be found in. Be wary of traps and poisonous spiders.

Equip any greegree you have already so that the monsters in the dungeon to [[Zooknock]] do not attack you, negating the need for prayer potions.

Rubble will constantly fall on you throughout the cave dealing small amounts of damage. This damage is negated if standing under the stone outcroppings when the screen rumble occurs. It is a good idea to bring [[antipoison]]s and [[food]]. Kill a zombie monkey in the cave and collect its bones.

Speak with Zooknock at the end of the cave with all three bones and talismans. Confirm that you want to make another (he calls it a talisman) greegree and then '''use''' the bones and talisman on Zooknock (he will pause after the conversation before giving you the greegree). Repeat this three times with the different bones to get all three greegrees.

===Awowogei's Palace===
{{Needed|Any [[greegree]], [[M'speak amulet]], [[Monkey nuts]], [[Banana]]}}
Buy [[monkey nuts]] and grab a normal [[banana]] if you haven't already. The monkey nuts can be bought from [[Solihib's Food Stall]] and the banana from the trees in the garden with the [[Monkey Child]] (not the trees to the south). Make sure you've equipped one of your [[greegree]]s and your [[m'speak amulet]], then go to [[Awowogei]]'s palace and talk to the [[Elder Guard]] to let you in.

'''Note: You must have started the quest by inspecting [[Awowogei]] at the table before the Elder Guard will let you through.''' 

Talk to Awowogei about his favourite food; he will refuse to divulge it, but will mention [[three wise monkeys|three monkeys]] in the temple. The three monkeys are located in the temple north of Awowogei, in the north-west corner of the ground floor. Asking either "What are you doing here?" or "Do you know anything about the king's favourite dish?" will lead to the player telling them that they are planning a surprise party for the king. The monkeys will tell you to stuff the [[snake corpse|corpse]] of a [[big snake]] with [[Sliced banana|banana slices]] and monkey nut paste. If you have a banana and the monkey nuts with you, speak to them again twice, one for banana and one for monkey nuts. These do not need to be processed beforehand. They will tell you that these are not good enough for the king's sophisticated palate, and that you will need to replace the ingredients with a [[red banana]] and [[tchiki monkey nuts]]. The normal [[banana]] and [[monkey nuts]] are no longer needed after this point.

'''Note:''' If your cooking level is at or just above the requirement (or you are boosting) the failure rate for cooking the [[stuffed snake]] is quite high. It is useful to obtain multiple [[tchiki monkey nuts]], [[red banana]]s and [[snake corpse]]s to avoid having to re-gather the ingredients. For the former two ingredients, the player must either drop or process (slice or grind) the ingredients or they will not be allowed to pick extras.

===Snake===
{{Needed|Combat equipment to kill a level 84 [[Big Snake]]|recommended=[[Antipoison]]}}
{{Instance}}
[[File:Killing big snakes.png|thumb|220px|Killing the big snakes in the pit on [[Crash Island]].]]
'''Note''': You cannot get the [[snake corpse]] beforehand. If you kill a snake before talking to Awowogei and then the three monkeys, you will get only bones.

Leave [[Ape Atoll]] and return to [[Crash Island]]. Go east until you find a [[pit (Crash Island)|large hole]] in the ground, and enter the [[Crash Island Dungeon|cave]] below.

You will find five level 84 [[Big Snake]]s. Since they are in [[Multicombat area|multicombat]], hit hard, and are [[poisonous]], [[Protect from Melee]] is advised. Turn it on before entering the cave. Kill one and take the [[snake corpse]]. You might want to grab multiple corpses since you might accidentally burn the snake. Try to stay away from the walls as more snakes (which are scenery) will appear and attack you.

===Red banana===
{{Needed|[[Rope]], [[gorilla greegree]], [[knife]] or slash weapon}}
[[File:Getting red banana.png|thumb|220px|Getting the banana.]]
Return to [[Ape Atoll]] and enter the city.

The [[red banana]] tree is located on the north-west coast of the island, just south-west of the [[gnome glider]] icon. To get the [[red banana]], wield your [[gorilla greegree]] as you'll need lots of strength. Then, go to the west coast and find the tree. Use your [[rope]] on it to get the banana (if you forgot rope, [[Ifaba]] at the general store sells some). Slice the [[Red banana|banana]] to get [[sliced red banana]]. You may want to pick more bananas in case of accidentally burning the snake later. To do this, your inventory cannot contain any unprocessed red bananas. Slice or drop them first to obtain more.

If no bananas are on the tree, go to the three wise monkeys again with a normal banana and go through the dialogue regarding it until it is finished.

'''Note: Do not return to the three monkeys with a red banana or sliced red banana in your inventory or they will eat it. This will only happen once.'''

===Tchiki monkey nuts===
{{Needed|[[Ninja monkey greegree]], [[pestle and mortar]]}}
[[File:Picking tchiki bush.png|thumb|220px|Picking the tchiki nuts from the bush.]]

Players with access to [[fairy rings]] may use the code {{Fairycode|CLR}} to skip part of the Agility course, though it may be faster to simply do it. Completing the course from start to finish is a requirement for the [[Western Provinces Diary#Hard|Hard Western Provinces Diary]].

Wield your [[ninja monkey greegree]], then go to the south part of town. The [[Ape Atoll Agility Course|Agility course]] start-point is on the other side of a small river. You will need 48 [[Agility]] to access the course. Boosts will '''not''' work for this, and pets cannot be be following you (they can be picked up and brought along). Once over the bridge, head south-west near the cliff to enter the agility course. Continue on the course until right after the rope swing to reach the broken hut around a hole in the ground. Go down and pick some [[tchiki monkey nuts]] from the [[Bush (Tchiki monkey nuts)|bush]], then grind them into [[tchiki nut paste]]. You might want to create more [[tchiki nut paste]] in case of accidentally burning the snake later. To do this, your inventory cannot contain any unprocessed tchiki nuts. Grind or drop them first to obtain more.

If there are no nuts on the bush, return to the three monkeys and use the standard monkey nuts on one of them and go through the dialogue regarding it until it is finished.

'''Note: Do not return to the three monkeys with tchiki nuts or tchiki nut paste in your inventory or they will eat it. This will only happen once.'''

===Cooking the snake===
{{Needed|[[zombie greegree]]}}
[[File:Cooking stuffed snake.png|thumb|220px|Cooking the snake.]]
After you have everything, slice the [[Red banana|banana]] and grind the [[Tchiki monkey nuts|nuts]], then stuff your [[Snake corpse|snake]] with them to create a [[raw stuffed snake]]. Be careful not to eat them yourself.

Go back to [[Ape Atoll]], equip a [[greegree]] (you will need your [[Zombie greegree]] soon, but cannot run with it equipped), and then go back to the temple. Go down the [[trapdoor (Temple of Marimbo)|trapdoor]] protected by [[Monkey Guard|gorillas]], then down one of the ramps. There is a crack in the wall between the two bamboo ramps. Go through it, and you will see a patch of hot coals. This is where you need to equip your zombie greegree, as the hot coals will prevent you from going to the other side and cause you to take repeated damage otherwise. Go to the long rock on the floor, boost your [[Cooking]] level if needed, and then cook the snake on it. It is possible to [[Snake over-cooked|over-cook]] the [[stuffed snake]]. You will know if you successfully cook or burn the snake, as there will be an animation when you try to cook it.

Travel back to [[Lumbridge Castle]], and make sure your [[m'speak amulet]] is equipped. '''Right click''' the stuffed snake and use it on [[Awowogei]]. If you eat the snake, you'll have to get another one.

'''Congratulations! Subquest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
----
[[File:Rantz chathead.png|left]]
'''Inspect Skrach Uglogwee in the Lumbridge Castle dining room to start the quest'''. Head to the Feldip Hills (fairy ring code {{Fairycode|aks}}) and talk to [[Rantz]]. He will tell you that he wants to travel to [[Karamja]] to make some type of [[Relicym's balm|potion]], but before that, he wants you to meet him south-east of his cave.

Walk directly south-east towards the transportation symbol on your map. Talk to him again, go through the dialogue; he will kick over a tree and ask you to make it into a boat. Use your [[axe]] on it '''twice''' to make a boat. 

Talk to Rantz again and he will shoot an arrow to a tree on Karamja. Talk to him once more and he will tell you to cook a [[chompy]] there for good luck. If you don't have any [[raw chompy|raw chompies]], kill a [[chompy bird]] or two and gather the raw chompies before you leave. If you didn't bring Logs, chop down a normal tree in the area to get one log.[[File:Recipe for Disaster - Freeing Skrach Uglogwee - fire location.png|thumb|220px|The location you need to make the fire.]]
Travel to Karamja:
*If you have used the [[fairy ring]] teleport (Karamja is {{fairycode|ckr}}) then make your way west towards the coastline and then north up the coast until you find a tree with an arrow in it. There are also dead trees to the west coastline if you still need a log.
*If you have travelled to Brimhaven, travel south past the general store and hug the west coastline.
The tree with the arrow in it is north-west of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] village, just north of [[Banisoch]], who is marked with a dungeon icon - the tree is denoted by the [[Transportation]] icon.

Make a fire next to the tree, and then, use your [[iron spit]] on a [[chompy]] and cook the skewered chompy by using it on the fire. If you succeed, Rantz's kids will take the boat to you and take you back.
{{Listen
|title = [[Hawaii 5 Ogre (Recipe for Disaster - Skrach Uglogwee)|Hawaii 5 Ogre]]
|align = right
|filename = Hawaii 5 Ogre (Recipe for Disaster - Skrach Uglogwee).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays while Bugs and Fycie approach via boat.}}
{{Listen
|title = [[An Ogre Sail]]
|align = right
|filename = An Ogre Sail.ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays when sailing via ogre.}}
Rantz will tell you to make a balloon toad to use as bait, to catch the [[Jubbly bird]]. (The Rantz near the water, there are two versions of him)

'''<u>Note: Purchasing jubbly from the Grand Exchange will not work. You will be met with the message "You need to cook your own jubbly meat to set Skrach free."</u>'''

*Fill your bellows up on the swamp—then, use them on a toad. You should get around three toads just to be sure, because the next part can fail.
*Mine the same amount of [[Rock (elemental)|rock]]s as you have toads to the west of the swamp, just north of the Fairy Ring, to get a "rock". There is also a mining spot next to Rantz's cave.
*With the rock and [[ball of wool]] in your inventory, inflate the bellows with swamp gas again; then, use them on your already inflated toad to create a [[balloon toad]]. The ball of wool is not consumed upon its creation, but there is a small chance that it will get used up as you create more balloon toads.
*'''''Drop''''' the balloon toad south of Rantz's cave or east of the [[gnome glider]].
[[File:Recipe for Disaster - Freeing Skrach Uglogwee - hunting jubbly.png|thumb|220px|The jubbly bird appears!]]
*Now, wait for the [[Jubbly bird]] (level 9). If it doesn't appear, you'll have get another balloon toad (If you're having trouble getting a Jubbly bird to spawn, log out and log back in. Note: Logging out will make you unable to attack the bird if it spawns). When it appears, kill it with your [[ogre bow]]. Then pluck it, take the meat, and '''''cook it on Rantz' ogre spit'''''. (Near Rantz's cave) Go back to [[Lumbridge Castle]] and then '''''carefully right-click and use the cooked jubbly on Skrach Uglogwee.''''' If you eat it, you'll have to get another one.
**Killing and cooking multiple jubblies may be beneficial in the event that you burn/accidentally eat some.

==Walkthrough==
----
{{Instance}}
[[File:Culinaromancer unfrozen.png|thumb|right|The Culinaromancer is unfrozen, and escapes back to his dimension!]]
After you have freed all the council members, you will see a [[cutscene]], where [[Aris]] restarts time by saying "Tempus procedit!" The Culinaromancer will then retreat through the portal back to his own dimension, where he'll be ready to cause more trouble. Aris then says that you too must go through the portal to finish him off.

When you're in the strange dimension, you'll find the Culinaromancer, a few white portals that lead back to [[Lumbridge]], and one of your previous quest bosses. The Culinaromancer is too strong to be defeated until you've defeated the first five bosses. 

'''Note:''' Prayer cannot be used in this dimension.

'''Note:''' You can leave and stock up after defeating each boss without losing your place in the fight.

'''Note:''' Upon trying to enter the portal, Aris will mention that due to dimensional instability, your items will be lost forever if you die. While it's true that no gravestone will appear in the world, '''her claim is false''' because your items can still be retrieved normally from Death's Domain.
===Agrith-Na-Na===
[[Agrith-Na-Na]] is [[Agrith Naar]] from the [[Shadow of the Storm]] quest, but he is now made of bananas and is level 146. He uses [[melee]] up close and [[Fire Blast]] at a distance. Agrith-Na-Na has decent magic attack and defence, so use your best melee or ranged setup. 

===Flambeed===
[[Flambeed]] is [[Fareed]] from [[Desert Treasure I]]. He's level 149 now. You need [[ice gloves]] to wield a weapon. If you attack him without ice gloves, your weapon will return to your inventory. He's harder to defeat without [[prayer]], but you should be able to kill him with plenty of high healing food. You can [[snare]] him, run away, and then mage him so you only use little to no food. He drops [[cake]]s.

===Karamel===
[[Karamel]] is [[Kamil]] from the [[Desert Treasure I]] quest. Fight her up close with a spell that has a lower level requirement than your actual Magic level, preferably a fire spell to take advantage of her elemental weakness. You should not be using your highest level spell, as Karamel will likely lower your magic level to the point that you are no longer able to cast it. Bring [[stat restore potion]]s and lots of food. Even with lowering your stats, Karamel is incredibly inaccurate. A good strategy is to use a [[Bolt spells|Bolt Spell]] with [[Chaos gauntlets]]. As usual, [[Melee]] doesn't work on her very well. Unlike Kamil, Karamel uses ranged attacks at melee range. Since her ranged attacks are not very strong, a good tactic is to stand right next to her so she uses ranged, which reduces how frequently she uses her ice attacks. Manually casting spells is beneficial due to her freezing effects stopping your auto-attacks. She drops a [[choc-ice]].

Note: Even though Kamil is immune to [[Iban Blast]], Karamel is not. Iban Blast can be used very effectively.

===Dessourt===
[[Dessourt]] is [[Dessous]] from [[Desert Treasure I]]. [[Melee]] doesn't work very well on him, however he is less resistant to [[stab weapons]]. [[Magic]] such as [[Iban Blast]] works well. [[Ranged]] also works really well on him. Bring lots of food, and then, defeat him as quickly as possible. He drops [[chocolate dust]].

===Gelatinnoth Mother===
[[Gelatinnoth Mother]] is the [[Dagannoth Mother]] from the [[Horror from the Deep]] quest, with that in mind you will need to bring Water, Air, Earth, and Fire runes in order to attack her during her weakness. She uses a ranged attack that rolls two hits per attack, one magic based and one ranged based. Each hit is capable of hitting for 20 for a possible max hit of 40 per attack. Players who have 80 or less health can die easily with a bit of bad luck and slow eating. The fight itself is fairly easy, although a bit long. She changes colour depending on her weakness. She has a low [[Magic]] [[Defence]] but high Melee Defence, making it best to not bother with Melee and just focus on maging and ranging. A great strategy is to mage her while wearing a mix of the best [[dragonhide armour]] available, a shield such as a [[dragonfire shield]], [[granite shield]], or [[toktz-ket-xil]], and melee helmet such as [[Barrows equipment|Barrows]]. Otherwise, she will rip through [[Mystic robes]] and other magic robes with her ranged attacks. This would give the player a balanced Defence against both Ranged and Magic Defence without sacrificing too much Magic attack bonus.

===Culinaromancer===
After you've defeated the [[Gelatinnoth Mother]], the [[Culinaromancer]] himself will attack you. He's level 75, hits high (can hit rapid 25s with magic), but has practically no [[Defence]]. He uses [[Magic]], but tries to get up close to attack as well. Kill him with any attack style and bring food. It is recommended to use armour that maximizes [[max hit]] (and to a lesser extent [[crush]] defence), as his magic attack has a flat 1-in-3 hit rate, so magic defence is irrelevant.

If you happen to defeat the Culinaromancer with a full inventory, the reward lamp will drop at your feet when you return to the Lumbridge castle. 

A cake will drop to the ground, but you are unable to pick it up. It is mostly symbolic.

Enter Cam Torum through the entrance and travel all the way north to the ruins entrance. Speak to [[Jessamine]] and ask if you could be of any help with the dig. She will then give you permission to enter the city. ===Remnants of the Old Ones=== [[File:Nahta chathead.png|left|frameless|width=110x110]] Enter the ruins to find yourself in an antechamber with a large black monolith in the centre. Speak to [[Attala]], [[Zuma]], and [[Jessamine]], in that order. Jessamine will tell you that inscriptions on the murals are written in the language of the [[Old Ones]], and ask you to help her set up camps in the surrounding caverns. [[File:Perilous Moons - mural in Neypotzli.png|thumb|300px|A mural found in the ruins.]] Take from the [[Building Supplies (scenery)|building supplies]] just to the west of Jessamine to obtain a [[hammer]], [[saw]], and three [[building supplies]]. To build the campsites, run to the cooking range symbol [[File:Cooking range icon.png]] on the [[minimap]] in each of the following rooms, using entrances in the corners of the antechamber: {| class="wikitable" |+Caverns !Cavern !Entrance |- |Earthbound Cavern |North-west |- |Streambound Cavern |North-east |- |Ancient Prison |South-west corner |} Beware of aggressive [[Sulphur Nagua]] in the Ancient Prison. Each time you build a campsite, your [[run energy]] will be fully restored. After building all three campsites, speak to Jessamine, who has finished translating the inscriptions. She will reveal that the ruins are called "[[Neypotzli]]," and that emissaries of unknown origins have been sealed here. Ask what to do, and she will give you a [[water talisman]] and [[earth talisman]], telling you that the power of "earth and streams" were used to seal the emissaries away. Attala will recognise the talismans, and ask that you bring them to [[Nahta]]. Nahta runs the magic shop, [[The Runic Emporium]], near the centre of the city and marked with a magic shop symbol [[File:Magic shop icon.png]]. She will enchant the talismans to react to [[naguanil]] magic, and ask that you take them to the [[Blacksmith (Cam Torum)|blacksmith]]. Speak to the blacksmith, found north-east of Nahta, in the city's forge, and a cutscene will play in which he will infuse the talismans. Return to Neypotzli with the talismans and speak to Attala; she will instruct you to use the talismans to guide you towards the location (within the dungeon) where earth and water runic energy resonate the most. This location differs for each player. Use the east/west pulling talisman to find the "column" and the north/south pulling talisman to find the "row" of the area you're searching in. Finding the location to travel to might require entering multiple doors. Use the [[world map]] to figure out possible connections between rooms. Rarely, it is possible to be required to go to the [[Lunar Chest]]'s room in order to find the correct location. ==== The ancient warden ==== [[File:Eyatlalli chathead.png|left|frameless]]When you are at the correct location and attempt to click either talisman, a [[nagua]] named [[Eyatlalli]] will appear before you. She will tell you that Neypotzli is a prison created to seal the [[Moons of Peril]], a trio of powerful [[nagua]]. The ground will then shake and she will disappear; return to the antechamber and talk to the group to find Zuma missing. Eyatlalli will reappear, telling you that the icosahedron has been disturbed and must be re-infused with a ritual. If you didn't bring the required tools for the quest, enter the Earthbound Cavern and search the supply crates next to the campsites you set up earlier. Obtain the [[big fishing net]], [[rope]], [[pestle and mortar]], and [[knife]] if needed. With the tools, collect a [[moonlight grub]] from the [[grubby sapling]] found slightly up the path in the Streambound Cavern, and use the pestle and mortar to grind it into [[moonlight grub paste]]. Run slightly north-east, towards a fishing spot on the bridge, and catch a [[raw bream]]. Use the knife on it to obtain the [[bream scales]]. Next, enter the Earthbound Cavern and head to the Hunter icon. Set a lizard trap on two adjacent rocks to create a trap between them, then rustle the bushes on either side of them until a [[Moss Lizard|moss lizard]] is caught. Use the knife on the [[raw moss lizard]] to obtain a [[moss lizard tail]]. Return to Eyatlalli with all three items. The Eyatlalli is now located in the central antechamber, return and speak with Attala to continue the dialogue and then speak with the Eyatlalli with the items. The ritual will be set in motion, but she will need to have you distract the Moons of Peril whilst she does so. Now you have to defeat three nagua, which are dangerous and each have different mechanics. [[File:Fighting the Blue Moon.png|thumb|300px|Battling the Blue Moon.]] == Strategy == ===The Moons of Peril=== {{Seealso|Moons of Peril/Strategies}} [[File:Eyatlalli's glyph.png|left|frameless|width=80x80]] The three Moons of Peril must now be defeated. Each Moon is located in its own room within the dungeon. The Moons can be fought in any order. You will need 38 [[Herblore]] and 30 [[Cooking]] in order to get ready for the fight. Each Moon will appear in the centre of the room, surrounded by moon-shaped circles on the floor. One of the circles will be highlighted with Eyatlalli's protection; while attacking the boss, players must stand in the highlighted circle on the floor to prevent the boss from dealing constant damage every tick. Damage taken while not standing in the right place starts at one (1) per tick, doubling over time up to 16. The circle highlighted with Eyatlalli's protection will move clockwise to the next circle every '''two''' attacks. When Eyatlalli's protection reaches the full or empty moon circles on the floor, the Moon will spawn a special attack. Refer to the sections below for information on the special attacks for each Moon. All of the Moons' standard attacks are melee-based, and each Moon is weak to different melee styles (listed below). However, they all have low Defence level (60), so players with high combat skills and decent [[melee gear]] should be able to take them out without needing to change styles. The moons have very high ranged and magic defence, and are immune to [[venom]]/[[poison]]. [[Protection prayers]] do not impact the damage taken in any way, and are thus unnecessary. Throughout the fight, [[Prayer]] can be restored by catching [[Moonlight moth|moonlight moths]] with a [[butterfly net]] (75 [[Hunter]]) or [[Barehanded impling|barehanded]] (85 Hunter) outside of the boss rooms in the Earthbound Cavern. Prior to heading in to each boss, you may restore your run energy at the camp and stock up on combat supplies. [[Raw moss lizard|Raw moss lizards]] can be caught using [[rope]] on the rocks, and [[raw bream]] can be fished with a [[big fishing net]] on fishing spots, both can be cooked at the camp for a source of food. The hitpoints restored by [[cooked moss lizard]]s is 1/3 of the player's Cooking level or 1/2 of their Hunter level, whichever is less; [[cooked bream]]s restore 1/3 of their Cooking level or 1/3 of their Fishing level, whichever is less. It is also possible to bank between fighting each boss without losing progress. With 70 [[Attack]] and [[Defence]], a [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|set of Guthan's armour]] and [[Super combat potion|Super Combat potion]]s can be used to make the fights easier to manage for lower level accounts. Using the passive healing effect of the armour set allows you to reduce the amount of food required. ====The Blue Moon==== The [[Blue Moon]] can be found by taking the north-western path to the Earthbound Cavern. Once in the room, you can click on the Hunter icon on the [[minimap]] to run past the [[wyrmlings]] and down the stairs near the entrance of the boss room. Once ready, head into the room directly east of the Hunter icon to go into the room prior to the boss. This Moon is weak to '''crush'''. {| class="wikitable" |+Special attacks !Attack !Mechanics !Method |- |'''Weapon Freeze''' |The Blue Moon unequips your weapon and puts it in a block of ice. Ice spikes will also spawn on the floor. |Punch the ice block to break it, avoiding the ice spikes that appear. |- |'''Brazier''' |The Blue Moon extinguishes two braziers at the edges of the room, and spawns moving tornadoes which disable run energy. |Run to each brazier to light it (no tinderbox needed), avoiding the moving tornadoes. |} Once she is defeated, you are teleported to a camp next to the room near the [[Blood Moon]] boss. If you log out while your weapon is taken during the weapon freeze phase, it will not be equipped when you log back in. To fix this, simply re-enter the fight. ====The Blood Moon==== [[File:Fighting the Blood Moon.png|thumb|300px|Battling the Blood Moon.]] The [[Blood Moon]] can be found by taking the south-western path to the Ancient Prison. This Moon is weak to '''slash'''. Contrary to some claims, it is fine to eat; this will not heal the boss. {| class="wikitable" |+Special attacks !Attack !Mechanics !Method |- |'''Raining Blood''' |The Blood Moon will disappear and rain blood from above, forming pools of blood throughout the room. |Simply move off of the blood pools on the floor. |- |'''Blood Jaguar''' |The Blood Moon will siphon up to 15 of your hitpoints to spawn eight [[blood jaguar]]s around the room, as well as a square of blood pools. |Run to the highlighted jaguar and attack it, remaining in the protected circle in front of it. Avoid damage by stepping one tile away from the jaguar (towards the boss) right before the jaguar attacks/when the pool animation is finished. If playing with sound effects on, click to walk away from the jaguar as soon as the sound of the blood pool forming finishes. Note: You do not actually need to attack the jaguar, but doing so will enable you to slowly restore up to 20 hitpoints. |} ''Note for 1 Defence accounts: The boss can be killed using [[ring of recoil|rings of recoil]]. The boss will not heal unless attacked, thus making 13 rings of recoil complete the kill. This will require deathpiling enough food to eat through her damage. A combination of brews and sharks works best. Alternatively, using just five (5) rings of recoil with a full inventory of [[Saradomin brew]]s can work, although it may take multiple tries to complete with this method.'' ====The Eclipse Moon==== The [[Eclipse Moon]] can be found by taking the north-eastern path to the Streambound Cavern. Head upstairs past the camp, past the wooden bridge and go west at the fork to head to the boss room at the southern portion of the area. This Moon is weak to '''stab'''.[[File:Fighting the Eclipse Moon.png|thumb|300px|Battling the Eclipse Moon]] {| class="wikitable" |+Special attacks !Attack !Mechanics !Method |- |'''Eclipse Shield''' |The Moon will spawn a moon shield and begins attacking rapidly with rays of light. The shield will move quickly around the boss in a circle. |Keep the moon shield between you and the boss to prevent damage from the attacks. |- |'''Mimic''' |You are teleported to the centre of the room and frozen in place. Clones of the Moon will spawn around you, attacking you. |Face your character toward each clone as it spawns to prevent damage. The simplest method is to click the tile below or behind each clone as it spawns. |} ===Finishing up=== Once all three Moons have been defeated, return to the Antechamber and speak with Attala, Zuma, and Jessamine. '''All''' of them must be talked to in order to proceed. Finish the quest by speaking with Eyatlalli. ==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
[[File:Emelio chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Make your way to [[Emelio]]'s house in [[Outer Fortis]], just outside the south-eastern entrance to [[Civitas illa Fortis]]. Alternatively use Fairy ring {{fairycode|AJP}}.

Recognising you as an "easterner," Emelio will enlist your help in a business venture involving something called a kabit.
[[File:Meat and Greet - spice box PIN.png|thumb|150px|The PIN pad for the spice box.]]
After you inform him that what he's speaking about is in fact called a [[kebab]], Emelio will share his goal of introducing the kebab to [[Varlamore]] by opening up a shop. However, he'll mention that the spices and meat he ordered have not been delivered yet, and will ask you to speak to the [[Spice Merchant|spice merchant]] in the [[bazaar]] and [[Alba]] at [[Ortus Farm]] to see what the delay is.

=== Supply chain issues ===
Head west into [[Civitas illa Fortis]], to the bazaar, and speak to the spice merchant in the south-eastern corner of the market. Ask her about the missing delivery, and she'll tell you the spices arrived that morning; however, [[Ali Morrisane]], her "reputable" supplier, sent them in a locked box. Offer to help her open the box, which is a four-digit PIN. Based on the brightness of the keypads, the order of the numbers is '''2546'''. Press the {{Mes|→|colour=white|size=14pt|bg=grey}} key to open the box, and she will send the delivery to Emelio.

Next, head further west to the [[Ortus Farm]], and speak to [[Alba]] inside the building. She will tell you the order was delayed due to a pack of wolves causing issues for the farm. You will offer to deal with it, and she'll tell you that their den is directly west of the farm. Run all the way westwards until you see a pack of [[dire wolves]], and enter the [[Wolf Den]] to face the level 113 [[Dire Wolf Alpha]]. ('''Warning''': the Wolf Den requires confirmation to exit - if overwhelmed, lower-level players may get stuck inside.) 
[[File:Meat and Greet - Dire Wolf Alpha safespot.png|thumb|360x360px|The safespot used to fight the alpha wolf.]]
The alpha dire wolf uses a strong [[melee]] attack, and can summon dire wolves that accurately attack with ranged. However, the alpha will only summon wolves if the player is within melee distance. Players can use a safespot to safely kill the alpha by quickly moving behind the stalagmites north of the cave exit at the start of the fight.

Return to Alba to inform her the problem has been dealt with. She'll tell you that the meat was delivered during your time away, so head to Emelio's house to check in.

===The golden ratio===
[[File:Vincens chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Return to Emelio's to find he has gathered three "connoisseurs" from the nearby pub, and given them the individual ingredients to try. He will ask that you find the perfect ratio for the kebab. Talk to [[Vincens]], [[Renata]], and [[Lucas]] for their opinions on the ingredients:

===Guerilla marketing===
[[File:Lelia chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Emelio will give you another two test kebabs to bring to [[Lelia]], located in the southern room of the lobby area of the Colosseum. Though initially skeptical, she will change her mind upon tasting the kebab, and will mention a free advertising spot that opened up for the next contest. She will suggests you head in, eat one of the kebabs, and fight a young minotaur as part of your advertising act. Prepare for an encounter with a level 193 enemy.[[File:Meat and Greet - fighting minotaur.png|thumb|300px|Fighting the young minotaur.]]
Lelia will ask if you are prepared before sending you in. Once you accept the fight, you will be brought into the arena, as the [[Colosseum Announcer]] advertises Emelio's kebab. You eat the kebab as instructed, but the [[Minotaur (Meat and Greet)|young minotaur]] will mistakenly believe you ate minotaur meat rather than buffalo, and will attack you in anger. If you die or leave the arena during the fight, you can speak to Lelia to re-enter.

==== The fight ====
The minotaur attacks with melee, can move at running speed, can path around the pillars, and is immune to binds and poison. It is weak to slash attacks. Protect from Melee will block all of its primary damage, but it can also use two special attacks:
* When it shouts {{overhead|Moo!}}, it will launch a '''magic''' attack. To block, switch to [[Protect from Magic]] until after the attack hits you, then switch back to Protect from Melee.
* When it shouts {{overhead|Moooooo!}}, it will attack 1 tick faster for the rest of the fight. This happens when it reaches 50% and 25% health. Keep Protect from Melee on during this time.
* Between 50-100% health, it will attack with melee three times and magic on the fourth. Below 50%, it will attack with melee two times and magic on the third. This rotation means it is possible to prayer flick the minotaur without taking any damage.

Since the minotaur's damage ramps up significantly in the later portions of the fight due to its attack speed increasing, lower level players with limited or no prayer restoration should consume their food first and save their prayer points for later on.

Once the minotaur is defeated, Lelia will be satisfied, and will tell you to return to Emelio and inform him of the good impression the kebabs made on the crowd. Return to Emelio, who will give you a premium discount on any [[Varlamorian kebab]]s you buy.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Job interview===
[[File:Pandemonium - Push.webm|thumb|width=250x250|Anne pushing you off the boat.]]
To begin the quest, talk to either [[Will]] or [[Anne]] on the dock immediately east of the [[Food Store]] in [[Port Sarim]]. They will eagerly offer you a role within their new salvaging business. When ready, you will be taken aboard their boat, and the pair will reveal that they want to collect some salvage from an old pirate wreck. They will put you in charge of steering the ship; after clicking the helm to control the ship, use the minimap to navigate south, through the [[Bay of Sarim]], to the wreck east of the [[Ship Yard|Karamja Shipyard]].

{{Map|align=left|name=Pirate wreck|x=3031|y=3035|r=3|mtype=square|caption=Pirate wreck location, east of Karamja Shipyard.|width=220|height=220}}

Upon arriving at the [[wreck]], Anne will ask you to lower the salvaging hook. After deploying the [[Salvaging hook (Pandemonium quest)|salvaging hook]], you'll retrieve a [[mysterious medallion]] and an [[old cup]]. Will, recognising the medallion, will take it and leave you with the cup. Anne will then shove you overboard.

===Pandemonium!===
[[File:The Pandemonium.png|thumb|right|250x250px|The Pandemonium docks.]]
You'll wash up at [[The Pandemonium]]. Speak to [['Squawking' Steve Beanie]], who will recognise Anne and Will as thieves that stole a map to the wreck, breaking the one rule of the Pandemonium. He'll point you towards [[Ribs_(The_Pandemonium)|Ribs]], the map's original owner.

Talk to [[Ribs_(The_Pandemonium)|Ribs]] in the [[The Pandemonium (Pub)|pub]], and he'll share the tale of Crimson Kraken, a deadly vessel captained by the cruel and vicious pirate Barnacle Barnaby. He'll claim that now that Barnaby's medallion has been found, a curse has been unleashed, and will ask you to talk to Steve Beanie again to find Will and Anne. Talk to Steve again, and he'll mention Old Grog, who might be interested in tracking them down. In the meantime, you'll need to acquire your own boat.

===Collecting cargo===
Head east out of the pub, and talk to [[Junior Jim]] on the second docked ship. After giving him the old cup in exchange for a raft, he'll inform you that you need to pick up cargo to get sails for the boat. He'll then take you to the shipyard, where you'll learn how to customize your boat (or in this case, raft).

Pick up a [[hammer]] and [[saw]] from the two open crates to the south, then board the gangplank. On your raft, build a cargo hold in the [[facilities]] hotspot, then use the gangplank to disembark your raft and return to Junior Jim. After giving you a [[Captain's log]], he'll ask you to head over to Port Sarim to collect the cargo.

Use the gangplank to the north east to board your raft, then use the helm to navigate and travel north past the [[shipyard]] to [[Port Sarim]]. Use the [[Buoy (Sailing)|buoy]] just south of the southernmost dock to dock your raft, then use the gangplank to the north to disembark. Take cargo from the [[ledger table]] at the western end of the dock. '''You must unequip weapons before carrying cargo.''' Return to the gangplank to board your raft, then open the basic cargo hold to deposit your cargo.

Navigate south back to the docks of The Pandemonium, parking within the perimeter of the buoys. Open the basic cargo hold and withdraw the crate, then use the gangplank to the north west to disembark. Deposit the cargo on the ledger table at the western end of the dock, and talk to Junior Jim to let him know you delivered his cargo. Finally, talk to Steve Beanie in the pub for an update on Will and Anne, and he'll introduce you to [[Old Grog]], who'll agree to help track them down.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Harlan's bounty===
[[File:Captain Harlan chathead.png|left|frameless|100px]] Head to the [[Lumbridge]] general store, located just north of the castle. Talk to [[Captain Harlan]] and ask if he needs help. Harlan will mention that a bounty of 1000 [[coins]] is available to whoever can bring justice to some thieves that robbed the general store, and that a traveller passing through noticed some goblins on the other side of the river playing with the stolen goods.

Cross the [[River Lum]] and talk to [[Mudfoot]], found by the house just south of the Lumbridge [[cow field]]. Mudfoot will explain that some humans dumped the stuff from the general store, showing the player the goods. He is on a quest to kill the thieves, and agrees to let the player join as a sidekick.

|mtype:pin,icon:yellowPin,3249:3249,title:Mudfoot,desc:Location of Mudfoot.

|caption=Quest locations: Mudfoot (yellow), the ranger (green), the mage (blue) and the warrior (red).
}}
{{Clear|left}}
===Goblin justice===
[[File:Mudfoot chathead.png|left|frameless|100px]] Return to the general store to find one of the [[outlaw (Mudfoot's Big Adventure)|outlaws]] roaming outside. 'Confront' them (left click) to start a cutscene, in which the outlaw escapes after Mudfoot fails to damage him with a hammer. Captain Harlan will interject, explaining to Mudfoot the theory of the [[combat triangle]], as well as melee [[attack styles]], and how this can be utilized against foes weak to the respective style.

Head north along the path towards the [[windmill]] until you reach the chicken field and talk to Mudfoot again, which will initiate combat with the ranger outlaw. [[Stab]] will be the most effective style against the ranger, but it may also easily be defeated with any combat style due to its low level. Captain Harlan may provide you with a [[bronze shortsword]] and [[wooden shield]] if you need them. On death the ranger will drop a [[shortbow]] and 80 [[bronze arrows]], which may be useful for the next fight.

Head south to find the mage outlaw by the [[H.A.M hideout]]. [[Ranged]] will be the most effective style against the mage, but it may again be easily defeated with any combat style. On death the mage will drop a [[staff]], 80 [[mind runes]] and 80 [[air runes]], which may be useful for the final fight.

Head south-east to find the final warrior outlaw in the [[Lumbridge Graveyard]]. Unlike the other outlaws, he will pray [[Protect from Melee]], forcing the player to use either [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]] attacks against him. [[Magic]] attacks will be most effective, and the outlaw is slightly stronger than the others. Very low level players looking to avoid damage may consider running around the graveyard until he aggros onto Mudfoot.

If you leave the fight area, you will need to retrieve Mudfoot from outside the H.A.M hideout before returning.

:'''Tip''': [[Pures]] looking to bypass the requirement to use [[Magic]] or [[Ranged]] may choose to use weapon poison. The outlaw will only activate [[Protect from Melee]] after your initial hit, which is capped at 6 for melee damage.

Once the warrior outlaw is defeated, he will drop an [[iron scimitar]] and [[iron kiteshield]]. Return to Captain Harlan to tell him that all of the outlaws have been dealt with. After returning the stolen items, Mudfoot will agree to split the bounty with the player.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
